meta.title: Context Formalization Pipeline Documents
meta.description: DDD documentation framework for Context Formalization projects — the layer that classifies every contextual input into six typed components (c1 Instructions, c2 Knowledge, c3 Tools, c4 Memory, c5 State, c6 Query), gives each a contract with shared metadata, provenance, temporal scope and component-specific governance semantics, and assembles them through an explicit Assembly Function A = Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize into a model-visible context bundle C with a runtime adapter, an assembly manifest and a validation report — before any optimization, measurement or LLM/agent runtime consumes it. AI reads this file and generates .md files in the correct order with proper cross-references.
meta.applicable_when: Building the layer that turns instructions, knowledge, tools, memory, current state and the current request into one typed, governed, model-visible context bundle C = A(c1..c6) — with explicit component boundaries, three separate governance axes (directive precedence ≠ evidence authority ≠ execution authorization), item-level provenance, temporal lifecycle, declared presence policy, typed conflict resolution and an auditable assembly manifest. Distinct from the source-formalization template (which ends at published knowledge artifacts — those artifacts enter this template as c2 Knowledge items) and from the ai-workflow and ai-chatbot templates (whose harness, prompt spec and knowledge base consume the bundle C produced here as their runtime input). Use this template when the questions are 'what does the model actually see, which component is each piece, where did it come from, which governance rule applies when pieces conflict, and can we audit or replay exactly how it was assembled' — not 'may we process this source' and not 'which context is optimal'.

agent_instructions.role: You are a context-formalization documentation generator. Read this file and produce each document listed in phases[], in dependency order.
agent_instructions.generation_order_strategy: Topological sort by depends_on graph. Phase 1 fixes the vocabulary, the shared component metadata schema and the governance axes; Phase 2 writes one contract per component c1..c6, then the cross-component rules (provenance, presence, assembly, runtime binding, manifest); Phase 3 turns contracts into code, prompts, validation, handoff and operations. Each document is the canonical source for its concerns — downstream docs reference upstream docs by document ID. Enum values are defined once in their owner document and only indexed in GLOSSARY.md.
agent_instructions.content_language: Write document content in Thai for narrative sections; use English for all identifiers, code, contract names, schema_version strings, enum values, field names and technical terms. Preserve jargon (component, instruction, knowledge, tool, memory, state, query, assembly, bundle, manifest, runtime adapter, payload, provenance, derived artifact, directive precedence, evidence authority, execution authorization, presence, conflict, staleness, verbatim, hash, replay) as English even in Thai sentences.
agent_instructions.quality_gate: Each document must cover all sections[] listed. Validate that cross-references (refs[]) resolve to real document IDs before finishing. Every contract, enum, governance axis, conflict class, assembly stage and validation check must be documented exactly once in its canonical doc and referenced elsewhere — no duplicate definitions. Never hardcode real company or product names — use placeholders or the fictional organization so the template stays reusable. Never invent a weight, threshold, score, probability or ranking rule: any value that needs calibration is declared as null with an owner_module.
domain_specific_notes: C = A(c1..c6) is a logical model-visible bundle, not a prompt string. RenderedPrompt is one representation of C; RuntimePayload = S_runtime(C) is the runtime adapter's serialization. RUNTIME_BINDING.md owns the adapter; ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md never assumes one universal serialization or ordering.

Three governance axes never collapse into one authority score: directive precedence (c1, INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md) ≠ evidence / epistemic authority (c2, KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md) ≠ execution authorization (c3 declares required permissions, c5 holds currently granted permissions). COMPONENT_METADATA.md deliberately has no central authority_class field — only governance_refs.

Formalization ≠ measurement ≠ optimization. This template defines structure, identity, boundaries and traceability. Weights, thresholds, top_k, relevance scores, information-value metrics and selection strategies are declared as null fields with owner_module in ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md and HANDOFF.md — never given a default value.

Tool definition ≠ tool invocation ≠ tool result. Only the definition is c3 (TOOLS_SPEC.md). An invocation is a runtime event; a result is a runtime artifact that becomes c2, c5 or c4 only when fed back, classified by semantic role and lifecycle, with provenance pointing to tool id and execution id.

Knowledge ≠ Memory ≠ State. c2 is domain/world reference with source and validity; c4 is persisted past interaction tied to a source_event_id and lifecycle; c5 is a current observed snapshot bound to observed_at and TTL. State is a represented snapshot, not a guarantee of truth — freshness must be checkable.

original_request is never overwritten by interpreted_intent (QUERY_SPEC.md). Request time, provenance, scope, exclusions, constraints, success criteria, ambiguities and assumptions stay explicit so a reviewer can compare what the user said with what the system decided to do.

Derived Artifact Rule (PROVENANCE_MODEL.md): a transformation that can change meaning produces a new artifact identity — never mutate the source identity. Nondeterministic transforms (LLM summarization, extraction) must persist the produced artifact when exact replay is required; transform metadata alone does not make replay possible.

Presence is an application policy, not a framework constant. PRESENCE_POLICY.md declares REQUIRED / OPTIONAL / CONDITIONAL / FORBIDDEN per component per policy_scope; missing REQUIRED blocks assembly; every omission has a reason in the manifest; empty components are never serialized as meaningful context.

Traceable ≠ reproducible (ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md). A manifest with item ids, component mapping, omission reasons and conflict outcomes is auditable; exact replay is claimed only when source/derived hashes, transform ids + versions + config hashes, persisted nondeterministic outputs, assembly version and runtime adapter version are all frozen.

Contract Governance Rules apply to every contract in this template: schema_version required; type + required (+ explicit nullable when null ≠ missing) on every validated field; no arbitrary weight or threshold presented as standard; provenance traceable in proportion to risk; original vs transformed values separated; policy invariants never reduced to a compensable score; validation tests generated from acceptance_criteria; the contract is an implementation specification, not the source of truth for business policy.

The running example is BriefDesk — an executive-brief assistant at Harborline, the same fictional logistics company used by the source-formalization template; published artifacts from that template's SourceVault pipeline enter here as c2 Knowledge with evidence_authority_class PUBLISHED_GOVERNED. Structural validation (VALIDATION_SPEC.md) always runs before any task evaluation or LLM judgment.

Isolation is not governance. Security scope (ACCESS_CONTROL.md) is a fail-closed eligibility filter evaluated at VALIDATE before the three governance axes are consulted. No policy can admit an item from another tenant, another subject, another audience or another declared purpose, and no conflict class covers such an item — it is omitted, or for a tenant mismatch the assembly is rejected.

Snapshot ≠ decision. c5 granted_permissions (STATE_SPEC.md) is evidence of what a principal held at observed_at and is a presence hint for assembly. A side-effecting tool call needs a context_authorization_decision/v1.0 re-resolved immediately before invocation; an assembled snapshot is never execution authority.

Capacity is a constraint, not a ranking. The preflight gate in ASSEMBLY_RUN.md computes and compares, then either fits, drops in the application's declared order, or refuses. It never scores, re-orders by relevance or summarizes to make a candidate set fit — selection belongs to the owner_module named in HANDOFF.md.

description.th: กำหนดขอบเขต task, คำศัพท์กลาง, shared metadata schema, การจัด source ลง component, สามแกน governance และโครงสร้างระบบ — ก่อนเขียน contract ใด ๆ
description.en: Fixes the task boundary, shared vocabulary, shared metadata schema, source-to-component classification, the three governance axes and the system architecture — before any contract is written.

description.th: ขอบเขต task, ผู้ใช้, output และสิ่งที่อยู่นอก scope ของระบบที่จะ formalize context — จุดเริ่มต้นของทุกเอกสารและที่แนะนำตัวอย่าง BriefDesk
description.en: Task boundary, users, output and out-of-scope items for the system whose context is being formalized — the root of every document and where the BriefDesk example is introduced.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONTEXT_DOMAIN.md that answers Step 1 of the methodology — Define the Task Boundary — for the project. State who uses the system, which task it performs, what output Y it produces and what is explicitly out of scope. Explain what Context Formalization is (turning 'things the AI probably needs to know' into an explicit Context Spec with component, source, temporal scope, governance semantics, mutability and assembly rule) and what it deliberately does not do (decide which context is optimal or most informative). Introduce the six logical component classes c1..c6, the Assembly Function A and the bundle C at mental-model level only — contracts come later. Distinguish course/learning order from runtime dependency order (Formalize → Formulate Decision → Measure/Evaluate → Optimize/Select → Learn). Introduce the fictional running example (BriefDesk at Harborline) and its raw inputs. Close with the top failure modes of unformalized context.
agent_hints.input_context: Use the fictional BriefDesk facts sheet for the running example: an executive-brief assistant at Harborline (fictional logistics company) that produces a daily five-item brief and answers compliance questions, consuming published artifacts from the SourceVault source-formalization pipeline as knowledge. Never name a real company or product. Do not define field-level contracts here — those belong to Phase 2 documents.
agent_hints.validation: Task boundary must answer all four questions (who, which task, what output, what is out of scope). Formalization must be stated as structure/identity/traceability work and explicitly not optimization or measurement. All six components plus A, C, S_runtime and Y must be named. The learning order vs runtime order distinction must appear. No weights, thresholds or scores may appear anywhere in the document.

description.th: ใครใช้ระบบ ทำ task อะไร output คืออะไร อะไรอยู่นอก scope
description.en: Who uses the system, which task it performs, what the output is and what lies outside scope.

items.text_th: Users and Task — ระบุ primary user, secondary user และ task หลัก เช่น BriefDesk: COO office ใช้สร้าง executive brief 5 ข่าวต่อวันและถามคำถาม compliance
items.text_en: Users and Task — name the primary user, secondary users and the main task, e.g. BriefDesk: the COO office produces a five-item daily executive brief and asks compliance questions

items.text_th: Output Y — ระบุรูปแบบ output ที่ระบบผลิต (brief, answer, action, decision) และสิ่งที่นับว่า task สำเร็จในระดับ business ไม่ใช่ metric
items.text_en: Output Y — state the output form the system produces (brief, answer, action, decision) and what counts as task success at business level, not as a metric

items.text_th: Out of Scope — สิ่งที่ระบบไม่ทำ เช่น BriefDesk ไม่ตัดสินใจแทนผู้บริหาร ไม่ส่งอีเมลออกภายนอก และไม่ประมวลผล source ที่ SourceVault จัดเป็น DENY
items.text_en: Out of Scope — what the system never does, e.g. BriefDesk does not decide on behalf of executives, never sends external email and never processes sources SourceVault classifies as DENY

description.th: นิยามและสิ่งที่ Formalization ตอบ — และสิ่งที่ตั้งใจไม่ตอบ
description.en: Definition, the questions formalization answers — and the ones it deliberately does not.

items.text_th: Definition — เปลี่ยน contextual inputs ที่คลุมเครือให้เป็น explicit representation ที่บอกว่าข้อมูลคืออะไร อยู่ component ไหน มาจาก source ใด มี temporal scope แบบใด มี governance semantics แบบใด เปลี่ยนแปลงได้ไหม และประกอบเข้าระบบอย่างไร
items.text_en: Definition — turning ambiguous contextual inputs into an explicit representation that says what each item is, which component it belongs to, which source it came from, its temporal scope, its governance semantics, whether it can change and how it is assembled

items.text_th: Not Prompt Writing — Formalization ไม่ใช่การเขียน prompt ให้ละเอียดขึ้น; text ก้อนเดียวตอบไม่ได้ว่าอะไรคือ rule, fact, ข้อมูลเก่า, state ปัจจุบัน หรือคำขอตอนนี้ และอะไร override อะไรได้
items.text_en: Not Prompt Writing — formalization is not writing a more detailed prompt; a single text blob cannot say what is a rule, a fact, stale data, current state or the current request, nor what overrides what

items.text_th: Not Optimization or Measurement — Formalization ไม่ตอบว่า candidate ไหนดีที่สุดหรือ information ชิ้นใดลด uncertainty มากที่สุด; คำถามเหล่านั้นส่งต่อตาม ARCHITECTURE.md
items.text_en: Not Optimization or Measurement — formalization never answers which candidate is best or which information reduces uncertainty most; those questions are handed downstream per ARCHITECTURE.md

description.th: C = A(c1..c6) และ Y = M(S_runtime(C)) ในระดับ mental model
description.en: C = A(c1..c6) and Y = M(S_runtime(C)) at mental-model level.

items.text_th: Six Logical Classes — c1 Instructions (ต้องทำอย่างไร), c2 Knowledge (รู้อะไร), c3 Tools (ทำอะไรได้), c4 Memory (จำอะไรจากอดีต), c5 State (ตอนนี้เกิดอะไรอยู่), c6 Query (ตอนนี้ต้องทำอะไร) — นิยามเต็มอยู่ใน GLOSSARY.md
items.text_en: Six Logical Classes — c1 Instructions (how to behave), c2 Knowledge (what is known), c3 Tools (what can be done), c4 Memory (what is remembered), c5 State (what is happening now), c6 Query (what is asked now) — full definitions live in GLOSSARY.md

items.text_th: A, C, S_runtime, Y — A ประกอบ components เป็น bundle C; S_runtime แปลง C เป็น runtime payload; M คือ model/agent; Y คือ output — C ไม่จำเป็นต้องเป็น prompt string
items.text_en: A, C, S_runtime, Y — A assembles components into the bundle C; S_runtime maps C to a runtime payload; M is the model/agent; Y is the output — C need not be a prompt string

items.text_th: Components Are Not Numbers — cᵢ เป็น logical component class อาจเป็น scalar, object, list of records, retrieved set หรือ tool schema collection; อย่าตีความสมการเป็น arithmetic
items.text_en: Components Are Not Numbers — each cᵢ is a logical component class that may be a scalar, object, list of records, retrieved set or tool schema collection; never read the equation as arithmetic

description.th: ลำดับการเรียนไม่เท่ากับลำดับ dependency ตอน implement
description.en: The teaching order is not the implementation dependency order.

items.text_th: Runtime Chain — Formalize → Formulate Decision → Measure/Evaluate → Optimize/Select → Learn; Formalization ต้องทำให้โครงสร้างถูกนิยามและตรวจได้ก่อน downstream จะ formulate objective หรือ optimize
items.text_en: Runtime Chain — Formalize → Formulate Decision → Measure/Evaluate → Optimize/Select → Learn; formalization must make structure defined and checkable before any downstream layer formulates an objective or optimizes

items.text_th: Boundary Rule — เอกสารชุดนี้หยุดที่ validated bundle C + manifest + validation report; decision variables, objectives, information metrics และ belief updates เป็นของ layer อื่นตาม HANDOFF.md
items.text_en: Boundary Rule — this document set stops at a validated bundle C + manifest + validation report; decision variables, objectives, information metrics and belief updates belong to other layers per HANDOFF.md

description.th: BriefDesk ที่ Harborline — raw inputs และ mapping เบื้องต้น
description.en: BriefDesk at Harborline — raw inputs and the initial mapping.

items.text_th: Raw Inputs — brief format และ policy rules, published compliance artifacts จาก SourceVault, candidate news articles, internal ops report, search/fetch/escalation tools, prior feedback, วันนี้ + active initiatives + สิทธิ์ผู้ใช้, และคำสั่ง "สร้าง brief 5 ข่าววันนี้"
items.text_en: Raw Inputs — brief format and policy rules, published compliance artifacts from SourceVault, candidate news articles, an internal ops report, search/fetch/escalation tools, prior feedback, today's date + active initiatives + user permissions, and the command "สร้าง brief 5 ข่าววันนี้"

items.text_th: Initial Mapping — c1 = format/citation/escalation rules, c2 = articles + published artifacts + ops report, c3 = news_search / artifact_fetch / kb_query / escalate_to_human, c4 = feedback + sent story ids, c5 = date + initiatives + role + granted permissions, c6 = คำสั่งวันนี้ — รายละเอียดใน SOURCE_INVENTORY.md
items.text_en: Initial Mapping — c1 = format/citation/escalation rules, c2 = articles + published artifacts + ops report, c3 = news_search / artifact_fetch / kb_query / escalate_to_human, c4 = feedback + sent story ids, c5 = date + initiatives + role + granted permissions, c6 = today's command — detailed in SOURCE_INVENTORY.md

items.text_th: Upstream Link — published artifact เช่น kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 มาจาก publication pub_sourcevault_nist53r5_ctrls_v1 ของ source-formalization pipeline และเข้ามาเป็น c2 Knowledge ไม่ใช่ c1
items.text_en: Upstream Link — published artifacts e.g. kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 come from the source-formalization pipeline's publication pub_sourcevault_nist53r5_ctrls_v1 and enter as c2 Knowledge, never as c1

description.th: ปัญหาที่เกิดเมื่อเก็บทุกอย่างเป็น text ก้อนเดียว
description.en: What goes wrong when everything is one text blob.

items.text_th: Unanswerable Questions — ข้อมูลมาจากไหน อะไรคือ rule อะไรคือ fact อะไรเก่า อะไรคือ state ตอนนี้ อะไรคือคำขอ อะไร override อะไร — ทั้งหมดตอบไม่ได้จาก prompt ก้อนเดียว
items.text_en: Unanswerable Questions — where data came from, what is a rule, what is a fact, what is stale, what is current state, what is the request, what overrides what — none answerable from one prompt blob

items.text_th: Operational Cost — แก้ยาก test ยาก audit ยาก และส่งต่อไป optimize ไม่ได้ เพราะไม่มี identity ให้เปรียบเทียบ
items.text_en: Operational Cost — hard to fix, hard to test, hard to audit and impossible to optimize because nothing has an identity to compare

items.text_th: Governance Risk — เมื่อ instruction, evidence และ permission ปนกัน ระบบอาจใช้กฎผิดประเภท resolve conflict ตาม GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md
items.text_en: Governance Risk — when instructions, evidence and permissions mix, the system may apply the wrong kind of rule to a conflict, per GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md

description.th: ข้อจำกัดด้าน governance, privacy, engineering และ mathematical scope ที่ทุก contract ใน project ต้องเคารพ — รวมกฎห้าม invent weight/threshold
description.en: Governance, privacy, engineering and mathematical-scope constraints every contract in the project must respect — including the rule never to invent weights or thresholds.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONSTRAINTS.md listing the constraints that bound every later document. Encode the eight Contract Governance Rules (schema_version required; type + required on every validated field with explicit nullable when null differs from missing; no arbitrary weight/threshold presented as standard; provenance traceable in proportion to risk; original vs transformed value separated; policy invariants not reducible to a compensable score; validation tests generated from acceptance_criteria; contract is an implementation spec not the source of business policy). State the mathematical scope: no assumption that components have probability distributions, numeric values, universal weights, universal thresholds or differentiable assembly; any value needing calibration is null / external configuration until evidence exists. Cover sensitivity and privacy constraints (sensitivity_class, memory of personal data, multi-user leakage), token/latency budget as declared metadata not optimized here, and the rule that structural validation runs before any LLM judgment.
agent_hints.input_context: Constraints must be expressed as decidable statements. Use the BriefDesk example only to illustrate a constraint (e.g. COO-office memory must not leak into another user's context). Enum values and field lists belong to their owner documents in Phase 2; this document only states the rules they must obey. The upstream boundary these constraints must not restate is CONTEXT_DOMAIN.md.
agent_hints.validation: All eight Contract Governance Rules must appear as separate numbered constraints. The mathematical-scope constraint must list the five things not assumed. Every constraint must be phrased so a reviewer can say pass or fail. No numeric weight or threshold value may appear except as an example of what is forbidden.

description.th: แปดกติกาที่ใช้กับทุก contract ในชุดเอกสาร
description.en: The eight rules that apply to every contract in the document set.

items.text_th: Rule 1–2 — ทุก contract มี schema_version; ทุก field ที่ต้อง validate มี type และ required ชัดเจน และประกาศ nullable explicit เมื่อ null มีความหมายต่างจาก missing
items.text_en: Rule 1–2 — every contract has a schema_version; every validated field states type and required, and declares nullable explicitly when null differs from missing

items.text_th: Rule 3–4 — ห้ามใส่ arbitrary weight / threshold แล้วทำเหมือนเป็นมาตรฐาน; ทุกข้อมูลจากภายนอกมี provenance ที่ trace ได้ตามความเสี่ยงของ use case
items.text_en: Rule 3–4 — never insert an arbitrary weight / threshold as if it were standard; every external datum has provenance traceable in proportion to the use case's risk

items.text_th: Rule 5–6 — original source value และ transformed value แยกกันเมื่อ transformation อาจเปลี่ยนความหมาย; policy invariant / authorization requirement ห้ามถูกลดเหลือ weighted score ที่ objective อื่นชดเชยได้
items.text_en: Rule 5–6 — original and transformed values stay separate when a transformation may change meaning; a policy invariant / authorization requirement is never reduced to a weighted score another objective can compensate

items.text_th: Rule 7–8 — validation tests ถูกสร้างจาก acceptance_criteria ของ contract; contract เป็น implementation specification ไม่ใช่ source of truth ของ business policy — policy จริงอยู่ที่ governance owner
items.text_en: Rule 7–8 — validation tests are generated from each contract's acceptance_criteria; a contract is an implementation specification, not the source of truth for business policy — the real policy lives with its governance owner

description.th: สิ่งที่ notation ในชุดเอกสารนี้ตั้งใจไม่สมมติ
description.en: What the notation in this document set deliberately does not assume.

items.text_th: Five Non-Assumptions — ไม่สมมติว่า component มี probability distribution, ว่า context value เป็นตัวเลข, ว่า weights มีค่ากลางสากล, ว่า threshold ใช้ได้ทุก application, หรือว่า assembly ต้องเป็น differentiable function
items.text_en: Five Non-Assumptions — no assumption that components have probability distributions, that context values are numeric, that weights have universal defaults, that thresholds transfer across applications, or that assembly is a differentiable function

items.text_th: Null-Until-Evidence Rule — ค่าที่ต้องมาจาก calibration, evaluation, optimization หรือ empirical distribution เก็บเป็น null / external configuration พร้อม owner_module จนกว่าจะมี evidence รองรับ ตาม HANDOFF.md
items.text_en: Null-Until-Evidence Rule — any value that must come from calibration, evaluation, optimization or an empirical distribution is stored as null / external configuration with an owner_module until evidence exists, per HANDOFF.md

items.text_th: Forbidden Example — relevance_threshold = 0.7, source_weight = 0.4, Knowledge = 40% เป็น optimization/configuration choice ไม่ใช่ formalization truth; ปรากฏได้เฉพาะเป็นตัวอย่างของสิ่งที่ห้าม
items.text_en: Forbidden Example — relevance_threshold = 0.7, source_weight = 0.4, Knowledge = 40% are optimization/configuration choices, not formalization truth; they may appear only as examples of what is forbidden

description.th: sensitivity_class, personal data ใน memory และ multi-user leakage
description.en: sensitivity_class, personal data in memory and multi-user leakage.

items.text_th: sensitivity_class — ทุก item ที่มี personal data, confidential business data หรือ regulated content ต้องประกาศ sensitivity_class ใน shared metadata และ assembly ต้องเคารพมันตอน PACKAGE
items.text_en: sensitivity_class — every item holding personal data, confidential business data or regulated content declares sensitivity_class in shared metadata, and assembly must respect it at PACKAGE

items.text_th: Isolation Is Structural — item ที่ persistence_scope USER ห้ามถูกประกอบเข้า context ของ principal อื่น เช่น preference ของ COO office ห้ามโผล่ในบรีฟของ ops analyst; กติกานี้เขียนเป็น predicate ที่ตัดสินได้ใน ACCESS_CONTROL.md ไม่ใช่ข้อความเตือน และไม่มี policy ใดอนุญาตข้ามได้
items.text_en: Isolation Is Structural — an item with persistence_scope USER must never be assembled into another principal's context, e.g. a COO-office preference must not appear in an ops analyst's brief; the rule is written as a decidable predicate in ACCESS_CONTROL.md rather than as a warning, and no policy may override it

items.text_th: Cross-Tenant Assembly Is a Bug — bundle ที่มี tenant_id สองค่าไม่ใช่เรื่องที่ filter แล้วจบ แต่หมายความว่า retrieval path ดึงของผิด tenant มาตั้งแต่ต้น — ผลคือ REJECT_ASSEMBLY ที่ VALIDATE และ tenant_id ที่ว่างหรือ null ถือเป็น OUT_OF_SCOPE ไม่ใช่ 'ไม่รู้ ปล่อยผ่าน'
items.text_en: Cross-Tenant Assembly Is a Bug — a bundle carrying two tenant_ids is not a filtering case: it means the retrieval path pulled another tenant's item in the first place, so the outcome is REJECT_ASSEMBLY at VALIDATE, and an absent or null tenant_id counts as OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than "unknown, allow"

items.text_th: Upstream Governance Inheritance — knowledge ที่มาจาก published artifact ต้องพก information_governance และ redistribution class ของ publication มาเป็น governance_refs ไม่ใช่ทิ้งไประหว่างทาง
items.text_en: Upstream Governance Inheritance — knowledge sourced from a published artifact carries the publication's information_governance and redistribution class as governance_refs rather than dropping them in transit

items.text_th: Retention Is Declared, Not Defaulted — item ที่ถือ personal data ใน c4, c5, c6 และ runtime payload log ต้องประกาศ retention class ตาม DATA_LIFECYCLE.md; ไม่มี artifact class ใดตกเป็น 'เก็บตลอดไป' โดยปริยายเพียงเพราะ storage ไม่ได้ลบให้
items.text_en: Retention Is Declared, Not Defaulted — items holding personal data in c4, c5, c6 and the runtime payload logs declare a retention class per DATA_LIFECYCLE.md; no artifact class falls back to "kept forever" merely because the store never deletes anything

description.th: budget เป็น metadata, determinism, validation ก่อน judgment
description.en: Budgets as metadata, determinism, validation before judgment.

items.text_th: Token and Latency Budget — budget ของ runtime target ถูกประกาศเป็น metadata ใน RUNTIME_BINDING.md และถูกบังคับเป็น hard constraint ที่ capacity preflight gate ใน ASSEMBLY_RUN.md; สิ่งที่เอกสารชุดนี้ยังไม่ทำคือ จัดอันดับหรือเลือก item ภายใต้ budget — candidate set ที่เกิน budget ถูกส่งต่อให้เจ้าของ selection ไม่ใช่ถูกตัดทิ้งเงียบ ๆ
items.text_en: Token and Latency Budget — the runtime target's budget is declared as metadata in RUNTIME_BINDING.md and enforced as a hard constraint by the capacity preflight gate in ASSEMBLY_RUN.md; what this document set still does not do is rank or select items under that budget — an over-budget candidate set is handed off to the owner of selection rather than silently truncated

items.text_th: Determinism Boundary — สิ่งที่ต้อง exact-replay หรือ validate แบบ deterministic ห้ามฝากไว้กับ free-form LLM judgment เพียงอย่างเดียว; nondeterministic transform ต้อง persist artifact เมื่อ replay เป็น requirement
items.text_en: Determinism Boundary — anything that must exactly replay or validate deterministically is never left to free-form LLM judgment alone; nondeterministic transforms persist their artifact when replay is a requirement

items.text_th: Validation Before Judgment — structural validation ตาม VALIDATION_SPEC.md รันก่อน task evaluation หรือ LLM judge เสมอ
items.text_en: Validation Before Judgment — structural validation per VALIDATION_SPEC.md always runs before task evaluation or any LLM judge

description.th: กติกาที่ทำให้ชุดเอกสารนี้ reuse ได้
description.en: Rules that keep the document set reusable.

items.text_th: No Real Names — ห้ามใส่ชื่อบริษัท ผลิตภัณฑ์ โดเมน หรือ credential จริง; ใช้องค์กรสมมติ (Harborline / BriefDesk) หรือ placeholder
items.text_en: No Real Names — never include a real company, product, domain or credential; use the fictional organization (Harborline / BriefDesk) or placeholders

items.text_th: No Universal Policy — ห้ามเขียน universal precedence rule หรือ presence policy ที่อ้างว่าใช้ได้ทุก domain; ทุก policy ผูกกับ policy_scope ของ application
items.text_en: No Universal Policy — never write a universal precedence rule or presence policy claimed to fit every domain; every policy is bound to an application policy_scope

description.th: คำศัพท์กลางของ Context Formalization — component ทั้งหก, A, C, S_runtime, Y, artifact vs activity, และ index ของ enum ทั้งหมดพร้อมเอกสารเจ้าของ
description.en: Shared vocabulary of Context Formalization — the six components, A, C, S_runtime, Y, artifact vs activity, and an index of every enum with its owner document.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a GLOSSARY.md defining every term used across the document set, one definition each. Define c1 Instructions, c2 Knowledge, c3 Tools, c4 Memory, c5 State, c6 Query with their one-line mental-model question and the boundary that separates each from its nearest neighbour (instruction vs fact, knowledge vs memory vs state, tool definition vs invocation vs result, preference-as-memory vs preference-as-query). Define A (Assembly Function), C (model-visible context bundle), RenderedPrompt, RuntimePayload, S_runtime, M, Y, Assembly Manifest, Validation Report, Context Spec. Define provenance vocabulary (entity, activity, agent, source artifact, derived artifact, transformation, produced artifact) and governance vocabulary (directive precedence, evidence authority, execution authorization, conflict, presence, omission reason, staleness, supersede, exact replay vs traceable). Provide an ID prefix convention and an Enumeration Registry that lists every enum name with its owner document — without re-listing the values.
agent_hints.input_context: Every enum is defined exactly once in its owner document (COMPONENT_METADATA.md, INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md, KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md, TOOLS_SPEC.md, MEMORY_SPEC.md, GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md, PRESENCE_POLICY.md, ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md, PROVENANCE_MODEL.md, VALIDATION_SPEC.md); this glossary only indexes them. Use BriefDesk ids (instr_, kn_, tool_, mem_, st_, q_, ctx_, mf_) as prefix examples.
agent_hints.validation: Each of the six components must have a definition, a mental-model question and a boundary against its nearest neighbour. C must be defined as a logical bundle, with RenderedPrompt and RuntimePayload as representations. The Enumeration Registry must name an owner document for every enum used anywhere in the set and must not list enum values. Traceable and reproducible must be defined as different terms.

description.th: c1..c6 พร้อมคำถาม mental model และ boundary กับเพื่อนบ้าน
description.en: c1..c6 with their mental-model question and neighbour boundary.

items.text_th: c1 Instructions — "ต้องทำอย่างไร?" directive ว่าด้วย behavior, role, policy, output contract; ไม่ใช่สิ่งที่โลก "เป็นอะไร" — domain fact เป็น c2 แม้จะอยากให้โมเดล "จำ"
items.text_en: c1 Instructions — "how must the system behave?" directives about behavior, role, policy, output contract; not what the world "is" — a domain fact is c2 even when you want the model to "remember" it

items.text_th: c2 Knowledge / c4 Memory / c5 State — "รู้อะไร" / "จำอะไรจากอดีต" / "ตอนนี้เกิดอะไรอยู่" แยกกันด้วย source, temporal scope, persistence และ mutability: PDPA มาตรา X = c2, user เคยชอบ executive summary = c4, user เลือก project A ใน session นี้ = c5
items.text_en: c2 Knowledge / c4 Memory / c5 State — "what is known" / "what is remembered" / "what is happening now", separated by source, temporal scope, persistence and mutability: a PDPA section = c2, the user previously preferred executive summaries = c4, the user selected project A in this session = c5

items.text_th: c3 Tools / c6 Query — "ทำอะไรได้" = declared callable capability surface (definition เท่านั้น; invocation เป็น runtime event, result เป็น runtime artifact) / "ตอนนี้ต้องทำอะไร" = immediate request ที่เก็บ original_request แยกจาก interpreted_intent
items.text_en: c3 Tools / c6 Query — "what can be done" = the declared callable capability surface (definition only; an invocation is a runtime event, a result a runtime artifact) / "what is asked now" = the immediate request with original_request kept apart from interpreted_intent

description.th: A, C, RenderedPrompt, RuntimePayload, S_runtime, M, Y
description.en: A, C, RenderedPrompt, RuntimePayload, S_runtime, M, Y.

items.text_th: A (Assembly Function) — explicit assembly contract Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize ที่เปลี่ยน formalized components เป็น C; ไม่ใช่ optimizer และไม่ผูกกับ text output
items.text_en: A (Assembly Function) — the explicit assembly contract Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize that turns formalized components into C; not an optimizer and not bound to text output

items.text_th: C / RenderedPrompt / RuntimePayload — C คือ logical model-visible execution input; RenderedPrompt คือ text representation หนึ่งของ C; RuntimePayload = S_runtime(C) คือ serialization เฉพาะ runtime ที่อาจแยก instructions, messages, tool definitions และ content parts เป็นคนละ field
items.text_en: C / RenderedPrompt / RuntimePayload — C is the logical model-visible execution input; RenderedPrompt is one text representation of C; RuntimePayload = S_runtime(C) is the runtime-specific serialization that may split instructions, messages, tool definitions and content parts into separate fields

items.text_th: M, Y, Assembly Manifest, Validation Report — M คือ LLM/agent execution; Y คือ output/action/decision; manifest คือ audit artifact บอก lineage ของ C; validation report คือ structural gate — ทั้งสี่มี identity แยกกัน
items.text_en: M, Y, Assembly Manifest, Validation Report — M is the LLM/agent execution; Y the output/action/decision; the manifest is the audit artifact describing C's lineage; the validation report is the structural gate — all four have separate identities

description.th: entity, activity, agent, derived artifact, transformation
description.en: entity, activity, agent, derived artifact, transformation.

items.text_th: Entity / Activity / Agent — entity = source, excerpt, summary, context item, bundle; activity = retrieve, extract, transform, assemble; agent = software component, human หรือ model ที่รับผิดชอบ activity — ตาม W3C PROV ที่ PROVENANCE_MODEL.md อ้าง
items.text_en: Entity / Activity / Agent — entity = source, excerpt, summary, context item, bundle; activity = retrieve, extract, transform, assemble; agent = the software component, human or model responsible for the activity — following W3C PROV as referenced by PROVENANCE_MODEL.md

items.text_th: Source Artifact / Derived Artifact / Produced Artifact — source artifact คือ entity ต้นทาง; derived artifact คือ representation ใหม่ที่ได้จาก transformation และมี identity ใหม่; produced artifact คือ output จริงที่ persist ไว้จาก nondeterministic transform
items.text_en: Source Artifact / Derived Artifact / Produced Artifact — the source artifact is the originating entity; a derived artifact is a new representation from a transformation with its own identity; a produced artifact is the actual persisted output of a nondeterministic transform

items.text_th: Traceable vs Reproducible — traceable = ตาม path C → derived artifact → source ได้; reproducible / exact replay = inputs, derived artifacts, transform versions + config hashes และ adapter version ถูก freeze พอให้ได้ bundle เดิม — คำสองคำนี้ไม่ใช่คำเดียวกัน
items.text_en: Traceable vs Reproducible — traceable = the path C → derived artifact → source can be followed; reproducible / exact replay = inputs, derived artifacts, transform versions + config hashes and adapter version are frozen enough to yield the same bundle — these are not synonyms

description.th: สามแกนของ governance, conflict, presence, staleness
description.en: The three governance axes, conflict, presence, staleness.

items.text_th: Directive Precedence / Evidence Authority / Execution Authorization — directive ไหนเหนือ directive ไหน (c1) / เมื่อ evidence ขัดกันประเมิน source-version-time อย่างไร (c2) / action นี้ principal ปัจจุบันทำได้ไหม (c3 ต้องการ, c5 มีอยู่) — สาม semantics ที่ห้ามรวมเป็น authority score เดียว
items.text_en: Directive Precedence / Evidence Authority / Execution Authorization — which directive outranks which (c1) / how conflicting evidence is weighed by source-version-time (c2) / whether the current principal may perform this action (c3 requires, c5 holds) — three semantics never merged into one authority score

items.text_th: Conflict / Outcome / Omission Reason — conflict คือ item สองชิ้นที่ขัดกันและถูก classify เป็น conflict class; outcome คือผลของ policy ที่ตรงชนิด; omission reason คือเหตุที่ item หรือ component ถูกละไว้จาก C
items.text_en: Conflict / Outcome / Omission Reason — a conflict is two items that disagree, classified into a conflict class; an outcome is the result of the matching policy; an omission reason explains why an item or component was left out of C

items.text_th: Staleness / Supersede / Presence — staleness = state เกิน TTL หรือ valid_until; supersede = item ถูกแทนด้วย version ใหม่โดยยัง trace ได้; presence = บทบาทที่ application ประกาศให้ component ต่อ policy_scope
items.text_en: Staleness / Supersede / Presence — staleness = state past its TTL or valid_until; supersede = an item replaced by a newer version while staying traceable; presence = the role an application declares for a component per policy_scope

items.text_th: Admission / Isolation / Quarantine / Retention — admission control คือการตัดสินว่า item เข้าร่วม run นี้ได้ไหม (ACCESS_CONTROL.md) ซึ่งเกิดก่อน governance axis ทั้งสาม; isolation คือผลของ predicate นั้นต่อ tenant / subject / audience / purpose; quarantine คือสถานะของ knowledge item ที่ต้นทางถูก withdraw หรือ revoke จึงใช้ประกอบไม่ได้จนกว่าจะ resolve (KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md); retention คือ 'ถือข้อมูลนี้ต่อได้อีกนานเท่าไร' ตาม DATA_LIFECYCLE.md ซึ่งเป็นคนละนาฬิกากับ staleness ที่ตอบว่า 'ยังจริงอยู่ไหม'
items.text_en: Admission / Isolation / Quarantine / Retention — admission control decides whether an item may take part in this run at all (ACCESS_CONTROL.md) and runs before any of the three governance axes; isolation is that predicate's verdict over tenant / subject / audience / purpose; quarantine is the status of a knowledge item whose upstream source was withdrawn or revoked, making it unusable until resolved (KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md); retention is "how much longer may we hold this" per DATA_LIFECYCLE.md — a different clock from staleness, which answers "is this still true"

description.th: prefix ของ id ทุกชนิดในระบบ
description.en: Prefixes for every kind of id in the system.

items.text_th: Component Item Prefixes — instr_ (c1), kn_ (c2), tool_ (c3), mem_ (c4), st_ (c5), q_ (c6) เช่น instr_citation_required_003, kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2, tool_kb_query, mem_pref_exec_summary_001, st_briefdesk_2026_09_04_0700, q_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001
items.text_en: Component Item Prefixes — instr_ (c1), kn_ (c2), tool_ (c3), mem_ (c4), st_ (c5), q_ (c6) e.g. instr_citation_required_003, kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2, tool_kb_query, mem_pref_exec_summary_001, st_briefdesk_2026_09_04_0700, q_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001

items.text_th: Assembly and Execution Prefixes — ctx_ (context_id), mf_ (manifest_id), cf_ (conflict_id), exec_ (execution_id), tr_ (transformation_id), evt_ (source_event_id), vr_ (validation report); assembly_version เป็น slash-versioned string เช่น briefdesk_assembly/v3; runtime adapter เป็นคู่ adapter_id / adapter_version เช่น provider_adapter_x / v2.1 ตาม RUNTIME_BINDING.md
items.text_en: Assembly and Execution Prefixes — ctx_ (context_id), mf_ (manifest_id), cf_ (conflict_id), exec_ (execution_id), tr_ (transformation_id), evt_ (source_event_id), vr_ (validation report); assembly_version is a slash-versioned string e.g. briefdesk_assembly/v3; the runtime adapter is an adapter_id / adapter_version pair e.g. provider_adapter_x / v2.1 per RUNTIME_BINDING.md

items.text_th: Stability Rule — item_id ต้อง stable ตลอด lifecycle; derived artifact ได้ id ใหม่ ไม่ reuse id ของ source ตาม PROVENANCE_MODEL.md
items.text_en: Stability Rule — an item_id stays stable across its lifecycle; a derived artifact gets a new id and never reuses the source's id, per PROVENANCE_MODEL.md

description.th: index ของ enum ทุกตัวและเอกสารเจ้าของ — ไม่ list ค่าซ้ำ
description.en: Index of every enum and its owner document — values are not repeated here.

items.text_th: Shared Metadata Enums — component_type, temporal_scope, mutability → COMPONENT_METADATA.md
items.text_en: Shared Metadata Enums — component_type, temporal_scope, mutability → COMPONENT_METADATA.md

items.text_th: Component-Specific Enums — instruction_type, directive_precedence_class → INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md; evidence_authority_class → KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md; side_effect class, failure_mode class → TOOLS_SPEC.md; memory_type, persistence_scope → MEMORY_SPEC.md; staleness_status → STATE_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Component-Specific Enums — instruction_type, directive_precedence_class → INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md; evidence_authority_class → KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md; side_effect class, failure_mode class → TOOLS_SPEC.md; memory_type, persistence_scope → MEMORY_SPEC.md; staleness_status → STATE_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Cross-Component Enums — conflict_class, conflict outcome, governance policy type → GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md; presence value → PRESENCE_POLICY.md; assembly stage, omission reason → ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md; artifact_type, transformation_type → PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; validation check status, report status → VALIDATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Cross-Component Enums — conflict_class, conflict outcome, governance policy type → GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md; presence value → PRESENCE_POLICY.md; assembly stage, omission reason → ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md; artifact_type, transformation_type → PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; validation check status, report status → VALIDATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Extension and Handle Enums — hard_or_soft → INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md; source_type → COMPONENT_METADATA.md; state scope → STATE_SPEC.md; owner_module → HANDOFF.md; governance_semantic (master contract) → ARCHITECTURE.md; INJECTION_SUSPECTED flag → PROMPT_SPEC.md — ค่าที่ template เพิ่มจาก workshop ถูก mark ว่า application-defined ในเอกสารเจ้าของ
items.text_en: Extension and Handle Enums — hard_or_soft → INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md; source_type → COMPONENT_METADATA.md; state scope → STATE_SPEC.md; owner_module → HANDOFF.md; governance_semantic (master contract) → ARCHITECTURE.md; INJECTION_SUSPECTED flag → PROMPT_SPEC.md — values the template adds beyond the workshop are marked application-defined in their owner document

items.text_th: Isolation and Privacy Enums — isolation_decision และ security scope field set → ACCESS_CONTROL.md; upstream_revocation_status, withdrawal_trigger, quarantine_status → KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md; retention_class, artifact_class, disposition, legal_hold → DATA_LIFECYCLE.md
items.text_en: Isolation and Privacy Enums — isolation_decision and the security scope field set → ACCESS_CONTROL.md; upstream_revocation_status, withdrawal_trigger, quarantine_status → KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md; retention_class, artifact_class, disposition, legal_hold → DATA_LIFECYCLE.md

items.text_th: Runtime-Safety Enums — run_status, revalidation trigger, capacity_outcome และ protocol stage → ASSEMBLY_RUN.md; authorization decision value และ revocation status → ACCESS_CONTROL.md; omission reason ที่เพิ่มใหม่ยังเป็นของ ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md เหมือนเดิม
items.text_en: Runtime-Safety Enums — run_status, revalidation trigger, capacity_outcome and protocol stage → ASSEMBLY_RUN.md; authorization decision value and revocation status → ACCESS_CONTROL.md; the newly added omission reasons stay owned by ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md as before

description.th: Shared metadata schema context_component_metadata/v2.0 ที่ทุก component item ถือร่วมกัน — identity, source, temporal scope, mutability, provenance ref, sensitivity, governance refs — โดยตั้งใจไม่มี authority_class กลาง
description.en: The shared metadata schema context_component_metadata/v2.0 every component item carries — identity, source, temporal scope, mutability, provenance ref, sensitivity, governance refs — with deliberately no central authority_class.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a COMPONENT_METADATA.md specifying context_component_metadata/v2.0 — the envelope every c1..c6 item embeds under metadata. List every field with type, required and nullable: item_id, component_type (six allowed values), source {source_id, source_type, source_uri_or_ref}, temporal_scope (six allowed values), mutability (four allowed values), provenance (object ref, shape owned by PROVENANCE_MODEL.md), sensitivity_class (nullable), governance_refs (nullable array), security_scope (object, required, shape owned by ACCESS_CONTROL.md). Explain why there is no central authority_class: authority has three semantics (directive precedence, evidence authority, execution authorization) that must stay separate, so the envelope carries only governance_refs pointing to component-specific policies. Own the temporal lifecycle semantics: what each temporal_scope value means, how mutability interacts with versioning, the temporal_contract fields (observed_at, effective_from, effective_until, ttl_seconds, superseded_by) and the lifecycle examples per component. State the Composition Rule (component contracts reference this schema instead of inventing their own source/time/provenance semantics) and the item_id_binding constraint.
agent_hints.input_context: This is the hub document: INSTRUCTIONS_SPEC.md through QUERY_SPEC.md embed this schema via contract_ref and constrain component_type and, where fixed, temporal_scope. The provenance object's internal shape is owned by PROVENANCE_MODEL.md — reference it, do not redefine it. Use BriefDesk items (a policy rule, a published knowledge item, a state snapshot) as worked metadata examples.
agent_hints.validation: Every field must state type, required and nullable. component_type must list exactly six values, temporal_scope exactly six, mutability exactly four. The absence of authority_class must be explained with the three-semantics argument. The temporal contract fields and their acceptance criteria (staleness check, effective-period check, superseded traceability) must be present. The Composition Rule must be stated. security_scope must be listed as a required field whose shape is owned by ACCESS_CONTROL.md, and the worked examples must carry it.

description.th: field ระดับบนของ context_component_metadata/v2.0
description.en: Top-level fields of context_component_metadata/v2.0.

items.text_th: Identity — item_id (string, required, non-null, stable ตาม prefix ใน GLOSSARY.md) และ component_type (string, required) ∈ {INSTRUCTIONS, KNOWLEDGE, TOOLS, MEMORY, STATE, QUERY} — นิยามค่าที่เดียวที่นี่
items.text_en: Identity — item_id (string, required, non-null, stable per the prefixes in GLOSSARY.md) and component_type (string, required) ∈ {INSTRUCTIONS, KNOWLEDGE, TOOLS, MEMORY, STATE, QUERY} — the single definition of these values

items.text_th: source — object required: source_id (required), source_type (required เช่น POLICY_DOCUMENT, PUBLISHED_ARTIFACT, TOOL_REGISTRY, CONVERSATION_LOG, SYSTEM_OBSERVATION, USER_REQUEST), source_uri_or_ref (nullable) เช่น kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 มี source_id pub_sourcevault_nist53r5_ctrls_v1 — source_id/source_type required ตาม typed-envelope model (SourceRef) ของ workshop; YAML schema ประกาศเฉพาะ source_uri_or_ref; ค่า source_type เป็น application-defined example
items.text_en: source — required object: source_id (required), source_type (required, e.g. POLICY_DOCUMENT, PUBLISHED_ARTIFACT, TOOL_REGISTRY, CONVERSATION_LOG, SYSTEM_OBSERVATION, USER_REQUEST), source_uri_or_ref (nullable) e.g. kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 has source_id pub_sourcevault_nist53r5_ctrls_v1 — source_id/source_type are required per the workshop's typed-envelope model (SourceRef); the YAML schema declares only source_uri_or_ref; source_type values are application-defined examples

items.text_th: provenance, sensitivity_class, governance_refs — provenance (object, required, shape ตาม PROVENANCE_MODEL.md), sensitivity_class (string, optional, nullable), governance_refs (array, optional, nullable) ชี้ไป directive / evidence / authorization policy ของ component นั้น
items.text_en: provenance, sensitivity_class, governance_refs — provenance (object, required, shape per PROVENANCE_MODEL.md), sensitivity_class (string, optional, nullable), governance_refs (array, optional, nullable) pointing to that component's directive / evidence / authorization policies

items.text_th: security_scope — object required, shape เป็นของ ACCESS_CONTROL.md (context_security_scope/v1.0): tenant_id, subject_ref, audience[], purpose[], legal_basis, classification_refs[]; envelope พก scope ไม่ได้พก policy — admission จึงตัดสินได้โดยไม่ต้อง dereference policy ใด
items.text_en: security_scope — required object whose shape is owned by ACCESS_CONTROL.md (context_security_scope/v1.0): tenant_id, subject_ref, audience[], purpose[], legal_basis, classification_refs[]; the envelope carries the scope, not the policy, so admission stays decidable without dereferencing any policy

description.th: authority มีสาม semantics ที่ห้ามปนกัน
description.en: Authority has three semantics that must never mix.

items.text_th: Three Semantics — Directive Precedence เป็น governance ของ c1; Evidence / Source Authority เป็น epistemic governance ของ c2; Execution Authorization เป็น requirement ของ c3 บวก granted state ของ c5 — ตาม GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md
items.text_en: Three Semantics — Directive Precedence governs c1; Evidence / Source Authority is c2's epistemic governance; Execution Authorization is a c3 requirement plus c5 granted state — per GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md

items.text_th: Design Decision — envelope ถือ governance_refs เท่านั้น; field ที่บอก precedence, authority หรือ permission อยู่ใน component contract ของตนเอง (directive_precedence_class, evidence_authority_class, permission_requirements) ไม่ใช่ที่นี่
items.text_en: Design Decision — the envelope carries governance_refs only; the fields expressing precedence, authority or permission live in their own component contracts (directive_precedence_class, evidence_authority_class, permission_requirements), not here

items.text_th: Failure Avoided — ถ้ามี authority_class กลาง ระบบอาจใช้ evidence rule ไป resolve instruction conflict หรือใช้ precedence rule ไปตัดสิน permission — ผิดประเภทกฎ
items.text_en: Failure Avoided — with a central authority_class the system might resolve an instruction conflict with an evidence rule or decide a permission with a precedence rule — the wrong kind of rule

description.th: ความหมายของ temporal_scope ทั้งหกและตัวอย่างต่อ component
description.en: Meaning of the six temporal_scope values and per-component examples.

items.text_th: Six Values — TIMELESS (ไม่ผูกเวลา), VERSIONED_POLICY (มี effective window ตาม version), HISTORICAL (เกิดแล้วในอดีต), CURRENT_SNAPSHOT (สังเกต ณ observed_at), REQUEST_TIME (ผูกกับ requested_at), EXPLICIT_VALIDITY_WINDOW (effective_from/effective_until ระบุชัด) — นิยามที่เดียวที่นี่
items.text_en: Six Values — TIMELESS (not time-bound), VERSIONED_POLICY (effective window per version), HISTORICAL (already happened), CURRENT_SNAPSHOT (observed at observed_at), REQUEST_TIME (bound to requested_at), EXPLICIT_VALIDITY_WINDOW (explicit effective_from/effective_until) — the single definition

items.text_th: Fixed Bindings — STATE items ต้องเป็น CURRENT_SNAPSHOT และ QUERY items ต้องเป็น REQUEST_TIME (constraint ใน STATE_SPEC.md / QUERY_SPEC.md); component อื่นเลือกตาม item
items.text_en: Fixed Bindings — STATE items must be CURRENT_SNAPSHOT and QUERY items REQUEST_TIME (constraints in STATE_SPEC.md / QUERY_SPEC.md); other components choose per item

items.text_th: Lifecycle Examples — c1 policy rule → VERSIONED_POLICY + effective window; c2 law/standard → published + effective dates; c3 tool schema → API/tool version; c4 memory → created / verified / superseded; c5 state → observed_at + TTL; c6 query → request time
items.text_en: Lifecycle Examples — c1 policy rule → VERSIONED_POLICY + effective window; c2 law/standard → published + effective dates; c3 tool schema → API/tool version; c4 memory → created / verified / superseded; c5 state → observed_at + TTL; c6 query → request time

description.th: mutability ทั้งสี่และ field ของ context_temporal/v1.0
description.en: The four mutability values and the fields of context_temporal/v1.0.

items.text_th: Four Values — IMMUTABLE (ไม่เปลี่ยน), VERSIONED (เปลี่ยนโดยสร้าง version ใหม่), MUTABLE (เปลี่ยนในที่), EPHEMERAL (มีอายุแค่ request/session) — นิยามที่เดียวที่นี่; state ที่เปลี่ยนต้องสร้าง snapshot ใหม่ ไม่ mutate snapshot เดิม
items.text_en: Four Values — IMMUTABLE (never changes), VERSIONED (changes by new version), MUTABLE (changes in place), EPHEMERAL (lives only for a request/session) — the single definition; changing state creates a new snapshot rather than mutating the old one

items.text_th: context_temporal/v1.0 Fields — observed_at, effective_from, effective_until (string, nullable), ttl_seconds (integer, nullable), superseded_by (string, nullable) — ทุก field optional แต่ต้องมีเท่าที่ temporal_scope ต้องการ
items.text_en: context_temporal/v1.0 Fields — observed_at, effective_from, effective_until (string, nullable), ttl_seconds (integer, nullable), superseded_by (string, nullable) — all optional but present wherever the temporal_scope demands

items.text_th: Acceptance — current state ตรวจ staleness ได้; versioned policy/knowledge ตรวจ effective period ได้; superseded memory ยัง trace ได้ในอดีต — "context item ที่ไม่มีเวลา อาจกลายเป็น item ที่ผิดเวลา"
items.text_en: Acceptance — current state is staleness-checkable; versioned policy/knowledge is effective-period-checkable; superseded memory remains historically traceable — "a context item with no time may become an item at the wrong time"

description.th: component contract อ้าง schema นี้แทนสร้าง semantics ของตัวเอง
description.en: Component contracts reference this schema instead of inventing their own semantics.

items.text_th: contract_ref Embedding — ทุก component contract ประกาศ metadata: {contract_ref: context_component_metadata/v2.0, required: true, constraints: {component_type: <fixed>, item_id_binding: <id field>}} — item_id ใน envelope ต้องเท่ากับ id field ของ item (instruction_id, knowledge_id, …)
items.text_en: contract_ref Embedding — every component contract declares metadata: {contract_ref: context_component_metadata/v2.0, required: true, constraints: {component_type: <fixed>, item_id_binding: <id field>}} — the envelope's item_id must equal the item's own id field (instruction_id, knowledge_id, …)

items.text_th: No Parallel Semantics — ห้าม component ใดสร้าง source / time / provenance field ของตัวเองที่ทับซ้อน envelope โดยไม่มีเหตุผล; field เพิ่มได้เฉพาะที่เป็น semantics ของ component นั้นจริง (เช่น observed_at ของ state)
items.text_en: No Parallel Semantics — no component may invent its own source / time / provenance fields overlapping the envelope without reason; extra fields are allowed only for semantics specific to that component (e.g. a state's observed_at)

items.text_th: Runtime Enforcement — component/item type mismatch, unknown field และ missing source ต้อง reject ที่ runtime ตาม SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md ไม่ใช่แค่ใน annotation
items.text_en: Runtime Enforcement — component/item type mismatch, unknown fields and a missing source must be rejected at runtime per SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md, not only in annotations

items.text_en: Scope on the Same Three — instr_citation_required_003 carries security_scope {tenant_id harborline, subject_ref null, audience [ALL_STAFF], purpose [DAILY_BRIEF, COMPLIANCE_QA]}; kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 has audience [ALL_STAFF] and purpose [COMPLIANCE_QA]; st_briefdesk_2026_09_04_0700 has subject_ref null but audience [COO_OFFICE] — an item that is about a person, such as a COO-office memory, carries a non-null subject_ref

description.th: รายการ context source ทั้งหมดของ project, Boundary Decision Guide สำหรับจัด item ลง c1..c6, กรณีกำกวม และกฎ one-source-many-items
description.en: Inventory of every context source in the project, the Boundary Decision Guide for classifying items into c1..c6, the ambiguous cases and the one-source-many-items rule.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a SOURCE_INVENTORY.md covering Steps 2–3 of the methodology. Inventory the context sources by kind (policies, documents, databases, tool registries, conversation history, user profiles, runtime state, current query) with source_id, source_type, owner and the components each may feed. Reproduce the Boundary Decision Guide as an ordered six-question procedure (directive? → c1; callable interface? → c3; request now? → c6; current mutable fact? → c5; past kept for continuity? → c4; domain/world reference? → c2) and the quick matrix. Treat the common ambiguities explicitly: tool result (runtime artifact; c2/c5/c4 only when fed back, by semantics and lifecycle), user preference (long-lived learned → c4; requested for this task only → c6 or c5), policy document (extracted enforced rule → c1; full text as reference evidence → c2), score/weight/threshold (record provenance; downstream owner). State the rule that one source document may yield items in more than one component when semantic roles differ, provided every item links back to the same source. Provide the BriefDesk classification worksheet with a one-line rationale per item.
agent_hints.input_context: Use the BriefDesk facts sheet: sources include the brief-format policy, SourceVault publication pub_sourcevault_nist53r5_ctrls_v1, news candidates, weekly ops report, tool registry (news_search, artifact_fetch, kb_query, escalate_to_human), feedback log, HR/calendar systems and the COO office's request. The pass condition is that two reviewers classify identically or explain the difference with a boundary rule. The six components classified here are CONTEXT_DOMAIN.md's, and the enum names used in the worksheet are owned by GLOSSARY.md's registry.
agent_hints.validation: The six-question guide must be in the stated order. Each of the four ambiguity cases must resolve to a component or runtime artifact with the deciding criterion. The one-source-many-items rule must include the linkage requirement. The worksheet must classify at least one item per component with a rationale and must include a tool-result case that is not classified as c3.

description.th: หกคำถามตามลำดับสำหรับจัด item ลง component
description.en: Six ordered questions for classifying an item into a component.

items.text_th: Questions 1–3 — เป็น directive ว่าระบบต้องทำอย่างไร? → c1; เป็น definition ของ capability / callable interface? → c3; เป็นคำขอที่ต้องทำตอนนี้? → c6
items.text_en: Questions 1–3 — is it a directive on how the system must behave? → c1; a definition of a capability / callable interface? → c3; a request to act now? → c6

items.text_th: Questions 4–6 — เป็น current mutable fact ของ session/environment? → c5; เป็นข้อมูลอดีตที่เก็บเพื่อ continuity? → c4; เป็น domain / world / reference information? → c2
items.text_en: Questions 4–6 — a current mutable fact of the session/environment? → c5; past information kept for continuity? → c4; domain / world / reference information? → c2

items.text_th: Quick Matrix — ต้องทำอย่างไร = c1, รู้อะไร = c2, ทำอะไรได้ = c3, จำอะไรจากอดีต = c4, ตอนนี้เกิดอะไรอยู่ = c5, ตอนนี้ต้องทำอะไร = c6; ถามตามลำดับ หยุดที่คำตอบแรกที่เป็น Yes
items.text_en: Quick Matrix — how to behave = c1, what is known = c2, what can be done = c3, what is remembered = c4, what is happening now = c5, what is asked now = c6; ask in order and stop at the first Yes

description.th: tool result, user preference, policy document, score
description.en: Tool result, user preference, policy document, score.

items.text_th: Tool Result — definition → c3; invocation → runtime event; result → runtime artifact; ถ้า feed กลับเป็น evidence → c2, เป็น current snapshot → c5, ถูก persist เป็น history → c4 — ตัดสินด้วย semantic role และ lifecycle ตาม TOOLS_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Tool Result — definition → c3; invocation → runtime event; result → runtime artifact; if fed back as evidence → c2, as a current snapshot → c5, persisted as history → c4 — decided by semantic role and lifecycle per TOOLS_SPEC.md

items.text_th: User Preference and Policy Document — preference ที่เรียนรู้มาก่อนและอยู่ยาว → c4; preference ที่ขอเฉพาะ task นี้ → c6 หรือ c5 ตาม representation; policy document: behavioral rule ที่ extract และ enforce → c1, full text ที่ใช้เป็น reference evidence → c2
items.text_en: User Preference and Policy Document — a long-lived learned preference → c4; a preference requested only for this task → c6 or c5 by representation; policy document: an extracted, enforced behavioral rule → c1, the full text used as reference evidence → c2

items.text_th: Score / Weight / Threshold — บันทึก provenance ของค่านั้น (ใครตั้ง จากอะไร) แล้วส่ง downstream owner ตาม CONSTRAINTS.md; ไม่ใช่ component item และไม่ใช่ formalization truth
items.text_en: Score / Weight / Threshold — record the value's provenance (who set it, from what) and route it to the downstream owner per CONSTRAINTS.md; it is neither a component item nor formalization truth

description.th: source เดียวสร้าง item ได้หลาย component ถ้า semantic role ต่างกัน
description.en: One source may yield items in several components when semantic roles differ.

items.text_th: Split Rule — org_policy_brief_v2 ให้ instr_brief_format_002 (c1, extracted rule) และ kn_policy_brief_fulltext (c2, reference evidence) เป็นสอง item ที่ metadata.source.source_id เดียวกัน
items.text_en: Split Rule — org_policy_brief_v2 yields instr_brief_format_002 (c1, extracted rule) and kn_policy_brief_fulltext (c2, reference evidence) as two items sharing the same metadata.source.source_id

items.text_th: Linkage Requirement — ทุก item ที่แตกออกต้อง link กลับ source เดียวกันผ่าน source_id และ provenance.derived_from_artifact_ids ตาม PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; ห้ามรวมกลับเป็นก้อนเดียวเพื่อความสะดวก
items.text_en: Linkage Requirement — every split item links back to the same source via source_id and provenance.derived_from_artifact_ids per PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; never re-merged into one blob for convenience

description.th: BriefDesk item ต่อ component พร้อม rationale หนึ่งบรรทัด
description.en: BriefDesk items per component with a one-line rationale each.

items.text_th: c1 / c2 / c3 — instr_no_fabricated_citation_004 (directive ที่ระบบต้องทำตาม); kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 (reference จาก published artifact ไม่ใช่ rule ของ BriefDesk); tool_escalate_to_human (callable interface พร้อม permission — ไม่ใช่ ticket ที่มันสร้าง)
items.text_en: c1 / c2 / c3 — instr_no_fabricated_citation_004 (a directive the system must follow); kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 (reference from a published artifact, not a BriefDesk rule); tool_escalate_to_human (a callable interface with permission — not the ticket it creates)

items.text_en: c4 / c5 / c6 — mem_pref_exec_summary_001 (past feedback kept for personalization); st_briefdesk_2026_09_04_0700.headcount = 135 (observed from hr_system at 06:55); q_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 ("สร้าง brief 5 ข่าววันนี้" is the request now)

items.text_en: Tool-Result Case — the output of tool_news_search run exec_ns_0904_01 is a runtime artifact; the article selected into context becomes kn_news_2026_09_04_017 (c2, RETRIEVED_UNVERIFIED) with provenance pointing to tool id + execution id — never c3
