items.text_en: Consequences — headcount 135 wins over mem_headcount_120 in cf_001; granted_permissions lacking perm:escalate.create makes tool_escalate_to_human a PERMISSION_CONFLICT cf_002

description.th: Contract ของ c6 Query — current ask ที่เก็บทั้ง original_request verbatim และ interpreted_intent, subtasks, scope, exclusions, required_output, constraints, success_criteria, ambiguities, assumptions
description.en: The c6 Query contract — the current ask, keeping both the verbatim original_request and the interpreted_intent, subtasks, scope, exclusions, required_output, constraints, success_criteria, ambiguities and assumptions.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a QUERY_SPEC.md specifying component_contract c6_query (context_component_contract/v1.1). Purpose: preserve the original request while making task intent and deliverables explicit. Fields (all required unless stated): query_id, metadata (component_type QUERY, item_id_binding query_id, temporal_scope fixed REQUEST_TIME), requested_at, original_request, interpreted_intent, subtasks[], scope[], exclusions[], required_output (object), constraints[], success_criteria[], ambiguities[], assumptions[]. State the GIST: c6 = current ask — keep both what the user actually said and what the system decided to do. Explain why: if only the interpreted intent is kept, no one can audit whether interpretation changed the user's meaning. Encode validation_rules (original_request never overwritten by interpreted_intent; requested_at and request provenance traceable; constraints and assumptions explicit when material; deliverables machine-checkable where possible) and acceptance_criteria (reviewer can compare original vs interpreted; scope and exclusions explicit; output validation can reference success_criteria). Distinguish a task-scoped preference (c6) from a learned preference (c4) and from a current condition (c5). Walk q_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001.
agent_hints.input_context: REQUEST_TIME temporal scope comes from COMPONENT_METADATA.md; the preference ambiguity is resolved per SOURCE_INVENTORY.md. QUERY_SCOPE_CONFLICT is defined in GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md. Use the verbatim BriefDesk request "สร้าง brief 5 ข่าววันนี้" and its interpretation.
agent_hints.validation: original_request and interpreted_intent must both be required and the never-overwrite rule must be a validation rule. All twelve fields must be listed. The audit rationale must appear. The preference boundary (c6 vs c4 vs c5) must be stated. Acceptance criteria must be decidable.

description.th: c6 = current ask ที่เก็บทั้งสิ่งที่ผู้ใช้พูดและสิ่งที่ระบบตีความ
description.en: c6 = the current ask, keeping both what the user said and what the system interpreted.

items.text_th: Definition — immediate task request พร้อม formalized interpretation ของ intent, scope, deliverables, constraints และ ambiguity: Original Request → Intent → Scope / Exclusions → Deliverables → Constraints → Ambiguities / Assumptions → c6
items.text_en: Definition — the immediate task request plus a formalized interpretation of intent, scope, deliverables, constraints and ambiguity: Original Request → Intent → Scope / Exclusions → Deliverables → Constraints → Ambiguities / Assumptions → c6

items.text_th: Audit Rationale — ถ้าเก็บแค่ interpreted intent แล้วทิ้ง original request ระบบ audit ไม่ได้ว่า interpretation เปลี่ยนความหมายของ user หรือไม่
items.text_en: Audit Rationale — keeping only the interpreted intent and dropping the original request makes it impossible to audit whether interpretation changed the user's meaning

items.text_th: Preference Boundary — preference ที่ขอเฉพาะ task นี้ ("วันนี้เอาสั้น ๆ") → c6 หรือ c5 ตาม representation; preference ที่เรียนรู้มาก่อนและอยู่ยาว → c4 ตาม MEMORY_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Preference Boundary — a preference requested for this task only ("keep it short today") → c6 or c5 by representation; a long-lived learned preference → c4 per MEMORY_SPEC.md

description.th: สิบสอง field ของ query record บวก metadata envelope
description.en: The twelve fields of a query record plus the metadata envelope.

items.text_th: Identity and Envelope — query_id (string required); metadata — embed context_component_metadata/v2.0 (required) พร้อม constraints component_type = QUERY และ item_id_binding = query_id ตาม COMPONENT_METADATA.md และ temporal_scope ถูก fix เป็น REQUEST_TIME; requested_at (string required) พร้อม request provenance (requester, channel) ใน metadata.source
items.text_en: Identity and Envelope — query_id (string, required); metadata — embeds context_component_metadata/v2.0 (required) with constraints component_type = QUERY and item_id_binding = query_id per COMPONENT_METADATA.md with temporal_scope fixed to REQUEST_TIME; requested_at (string, required) with request provenance (requester, channel) in metadata.source

items.text_th: Request and Intent — original_request (string required, verbatim ห้ามแก้แม้ตัวสะกด) และ interpreted_intent (string required) เป็นสอง field แยกกันเสมอ
items.text_en: Request and Intent — original_request (string, required, verbatim, not even spelling corrected) and interpreted_intent (string, required) are always two separate fields

items.text_th: Decomposition — subtasks[], scope[], exclusions[], required_output (object), constraints[], success_criteria[], ambiguities[], assumptions[] — ทุก field required; array ว่างต้อง explicit
items.text_en: Decomposition — subtasks[], scope[], exclusions[], required_output (object), constraints[], success_criteria[], ambiguities[], assumptions[] — all required; empty arrays are explicit

description.th: กฎที่ validator ตรวจกับ query
description.en: Rules the validator checks on a query.

items.text_th: Never Overwrite — original_request ห้ามถูกเขียนทับด้วย interpreted_intent; validator เปรียบเทียบ hash ของ original_request กับค่าที่ ingest ตอน requested_at
items.text_en: Never Overwrite — original_request is never overwritten by interpreted_intent; the validator compares the original_request hash against the value ingested at requested_at

items.text_th: Traceable Request — requested_at และ request provenance trace ได้; constraints และ assumptions explicit เมื่อมีผลต่อ execution อย่างมีนัย; deliverables machine-checkable เท่าที่เป็นไปได้
items.text_en: Traceable Request — requested_at and request provenance are traceable; constraints and assumptions are explicit when they materially affect execution; deliverables are machine-checkable where possible

items.text_th: Scope Discipline — interpreted_intent หรือ subtasks ที่เกิน scope/exclusions ที่ประกาศคือ QUERY_SCOPE_CONFLICT ตาม GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md ไม่ใช่การขยาย scope เงียบ ๆ
items.text_en: Scope Discipline — an interpreted_intent or subtask beyond the declared scope/exclusions is a QUERY_SCOPE_CONFLICT per GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md, never a silent scope expansion

items.text_th: Never Overwrite, but Erasable — กฎห้ามแก้ original_request ยังอยู่เหมือนเดิม; การลบข้อมูลตามคำขอไม่ใช่การแก้ข้อความ แต่คือการทำลาย payload แล้วเหลือ tombstone ที่ยังพก hash เดิมไว้ตาม DATA_LIFECYCLE.md — สองกฎนี้จึงอยู่ด้วยกันได้โดยไม่ขัดกัน
items.text_en: Never Overwrite, but Erasable — the rule against editing original_request stands unchanged; honouring an erasure is not editing the text but destroying the payload and leaving a tombstone that still carries the original hash per DATA_LIFECYCLE.md — so the two rules coexist without contradiction

description.th: เกณฑ์ที่ตัดสินได้

items.text_th: Comparable — reviewer เปรียบเทียบ original request กับ interpreted task ได้ข้างกัน

items.text_th: Explicit Scope — scope และ exclusions ระบุชัด; output validation อ้าง success_criteria ที่ประกาศได้

description.th: Contract context_provenance/v1.1 — entity / transformation_activity / component_item_id, Derived Artifact Rule, minimum provenance chain, การ persist nondeterministic output และ mapping ไป W3C PROV
description.en: The context_provenance/v1.1 contract — entity / transformation_activity / component_item_id, the Derived Artifact Rule, the minimum provenance chain, persisting nondeterministic outputs and the mapping to W3C PROV.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a PROVENANCE_MODEL.md specifying context_provenance/v1.1. Define provenance as metadata + artifact linkage connecting a derived context item back to its source, transformation activity, version/configuration and the artifact actually produced. Use the entity / activity / agent split (entity = source, excerpt, summary, context item, bundle; activity = retrieve, extract, transform, assemble; agent = software component, human or model) and map it to W3C PROV terms using references/w3c-prov-core-concepts.md — note that model weights and prompt configs are Entities/Plans, inference is an Activity, the executing service is a SoftwareAgent. State the Derived Artifact Rule with the chain law_001 → excerpt_014 (extract/v3) → summary_031 (summarize/prompt-v7/model-X) → context_bundle_009 (assemble/v2): never mutate a source item and pretend its identity is unchanged when a transformation may alter meaning or granularity. Give the minimum provenance chain from Source Entity through Runtime Payload to Y. Specify the contract: entity {artifact_id, artifact_type, content_hash_or_ref, derived_from_artifact_ids[]} all required; transformation_activity {transformation_id, transformation_type, transformation_version, transformation_config_hash, executor_or_model_ref, produced_artifact_id} all nullable; component_item_id required. Own artifact_type and transformation_type example values. Encode the acceptance criteria (traceable to ≥1 artifact; derived content gets its own identity; transformations ordered and versioned when replay requires; nondeterministic transforms persist produced artifact; verbatim and derived text distinguishable).
agent_hints.input_context: Read references/w3c-prov-core-concepts.md for the PROV vocabulary and the 'model weights are an Entity, not an Agent' nuance. The provenance object embedded in every component's metadata (COMPONENT_METADATA.md) has the entity shape defined here. Provenance does not decide authority, relevance or truth — those are GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md and downstream concerns. Use BriefDesk transformations: tr_summarize_news_v7 producing a summary item from kn_news_2026_09_04_017.
agent_hints.validation: The entity / activity / agent split must map to PROV terms with the weights-as-Entity nuance stated. The Derived Artifact Rule must include the four-step chain and the persist-nondeterministic-output requirement. Every contract field must state type/required/nullable. All five acceptance criteria must be decidable. artifact_type and transformation_type values must be defined once here.

description.th: provenance คืออะไรและ map ไป Entity / Activity / Agent อย่างไร
description.en: What provenance is and how it maps to Entity / Activity / Agent.

items.text_th: Definition — metadata + artifact linkage ที่เชื่อม derived context item กลับไปยัง source, transformation activity, version/configuration และ artifact ที่ถูกผลิตขึ้นจริง — สำคัญเป็นพิเศษเมื่อ transformation ใช้ LLM ที่ output ไม่เหมือนเดิมทุกครั้ง
items.text_en: Definition — metadata + artifact linkage connecting a derived context item back to its source, transformation activity, version/configuration and the artifact actually produced — especially important when a transformation uses an LLM whose output varies

items.text_th: PROV Split — Entity = source, excerpt, summary, context item, bundle (prov:Entity); Activity = retrieve, extract, transform, assemble (prov:Activity, wasGeneratedBy / used / wasDerivedFrom); Agent = software component, human, model service (prov:Agent, wasAssociatedWith) — ตาม references/w3c-prov-core-concepts.md
items.text_en: PROV Split — Entity = source, excerpt, summary, context item, bundle (prov:Entity); Activity = retrieve, extract, transform, assemble (prov:Activity, wasGeneratedBy / used / wasDerivedFrom); Agent = software component, human, model service (prov:Agent, wasAssociatedWith) — per references/w3c-prov-core-concepts.md

items.text_th: Model Is Not an Agent — model weights และ prompt/config เป็น Entity (prov:Plan); inference call เป็น Activity; service ที่รัน inference เป็น SoftwareAgent — จึงบอกได้ว่า model version ไหนถูกใช้โดย service ไหน; ไม่บังคับ RDF — เริ่มด้วย typed JSON/YAML แล้ว export PROV-JSON เมื่อจำเป็น
items.text_en: Model Is Not an Agent — model weights and prompt/config are Entities (prov:Plan); the inference call is an Activity; the service running it is a SoftwareAgent — so one can say which model version was used by which service; RDF is not required — start with typed JSON/YAML and export PROV-JSON when needed

description.th: อย่า mutate source แล้วอ้าง identity เดิม
description.en: Never mutate a source and keep claiming its identity.

items.text_th: Rule — เมื่อ transformation สร้าง representation ใหม่ที่อาจมีความหมายหรือความละเอียดต่างจากต้นฉบับ ให้สร้าง artifact identity ใหม่: law_001 (Source Entity) → extract/v3 → excerpt_014 → summarize/prompt-v7/model-X → summary_031 → assemble/v2 → context_bundle_009 (ทุกตัวเป็น Derived Entity)
items.text_en: Rule — when a transformation creates a new representation that may differ in meaning or granularity from the original, mint a new artifact identity: law_001 (Source Entity) → extract/v3 → excerpt_014 → summarize/prompt-v7/model-X → summary_031 → assemble/v2 → context_bundle_009 (each a Derived Entity)

items.text_th: Persist Nondeterministic Output — ถ้า transform เป็น nondeterministic และต้องการ exact replay ให้ persist produced artifact (เช่น summary_031) แทนหวังว่าจะ regenerate เหมือนเดิมจาก transform metadata; สอดคล้อง CONSTRAINTS.md Rule 5
items.text_en: Persist Nondeterministic Output — if a transform is nondeterministic and exact replay is required, persist the produced artifact (e.g. summary_031) instead of hoping to regenerate it from transform metadata; consistent with CONSTRAINTS.md Rule 5

items.text_th: Verbatim vs Derived — content ที่ verbatim จาก source และ derived text ต้องแยกกันได้เสมอ; knowledge item ที่เป็น summary ได้ knowledge_id ใหม่ตาม KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Verbatim vs Derived — verbatim source content and derived text must always be distinguishable; a summary knowledge item gets its own knowledge_id per KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md

description.th: จาก Source Entity ถึง Y
description.en: From Source Entity to Y.

items.text_th: Chain — Source Entity → Retrieval / Extraction Activity → Derived Artifact → Transformation Activity → Component Item → Assembly Activity → Assembly Manifest + Context Bundle C → Runtime Adapter → Runtime Payload → Execution → Y
items.text_en: Chain — Source Entity → Retrieval / Extraction Activity → Derived Artifact → Transformation Activity → Component Item → Assembly Activity → Assembly Manifest + Context Bundle C → Runtime Adapter → Runtime Payload → Execution → Y

items.text_th: Audit Path — production audit trace output → runtime payload → context → derived artifact → source ได้ทางเดียวผ่าน ids ใน ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md และ execution boundary ใน RUNTIME_BINDING.md
items.text_en: Audit Path — a production audit traces output → runtime payload → context → derived artifact → source in one direction through the ids in ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md and the execution boundary in RUNTIME_BINDING.md

items.text_th: GIST — ถ้า trace กลับ source และ transformation path ไม่ได้ เราอาจใช้ข้อมูลได้ แต่ audit และ replay ได้ไม่ดีพอ
items.text_en: GIST — without a path back to the source and its transformations we may still use the data, but we cannot audit or replay it well enough

items.text_en: entity — artifact_id (string, required), artifact_type (string, required ∈ e.g. SOURCE_ARTIFACT, DERIVED_ARTIFACT, COMPONENT_ITEM, CONTEXT_BUNDLE, RUNTIME_PAYLOAD, VALIDATION_REPORT — example values owned here), content_hash_or_ref (string, required), derived_from_artifact_ids (array, required, empty only for SOURCE_ARTIFACT)

items.text_en: transformation_activity — transformation_id, transformation_type (e.g. RETRIEVE, EXTRACT, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE, NORMALIZE, ASSEMBLE — example values owned here), transformation_version, transformation_config_hash, executor_or_model_ref, produced_artifact_id — all string, optional, nullable; null only when the item is verbatim from its source

items.text_en: component_item_id — string, required: the item this provenance describes; must equal that item's metadata.item_id per COMPONENT_METADATA.md

description.th: ห้าเกณฑ์ที่ตัดสินได้
description.en: Five decidable criteria.

items.text_th: Traceable and Distinct — ทุก assembled item trace ไป source/derived artifact ได้อย่างน้อยหนึ่ง; derived content ได้ artifact/item identity ที่แยกได้ ไม่ mutate source identity เงียบ ๆ
items.text_en: Traceable and Distinct — every assembled item traces to at least one source/derived artifact; derived content receives a distinguishable artifact/item identity rather than silently mutating the source's

items.text_th: Ordered, Versioned, Persisted — transformation ถูก order และ version เมื่อ replay/audit ต้องการ; nondeterministic transform persist produced artifact เมื่อต้อง exact replay
items.text_en: Ordered, Versioned, Persisted — transformations are ordered and versioned when replay/audit requires; nondeterministic transforms persist their produced artifact when exact replay is required

items.text_th: Verbatim Distinguishable — verbatim source content และ derived text แยกกันได้ใน validator ไม่ใช่แค่โดยคนอ่าน
items.text_en: Verbatim Distinguishable — verbatim source content and derived text are distinguishable by the validator, not just by a human reader

description.th: Contract context_component_presence/v1.1 — REQUIRED / OPTIONAL / CONDITIONAL / FORBIDDEN ต่อ component ต่อ policy_scope, omission reason และกฎว่า component ว่างไม่ใช่ context ที่มีความหมาย
description.en: The context_component_presence/v1.1 contract — REQUIRED / OPTIONAL / CONDITIONAL / FORBIDDEN per component per policy_scope, omission reasons and the rule that an empty component is not meaningful context.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a PRESENCE_POLICY.md specifying context_component_presence/v1.1. State the GIST: formalization says what role each component plays — it does not force every task to use every component; stuffing all six in because the framework has six creates unnecessary context and coupling. Own the presence enum REQUIRED / OPTIONAL / CONDITIONAL / FORBIDDEN and explain that presence is an application policy bound to a policy_scope, not a universal constant. Give the example policy for an interactive assistant (c1 REQUIRED, c2 CONDITIONAL, c3 CONDITIONAL, c4 OPTIONAL, c5 CONDITIONAL, c6 REQUIRED) explicitly labelled as one policy among many, then the BriefDesk policies (BRIEFDESK_DAILY_BRIEF and BRIEFDESK_COMPLIANCE_QA). Define how CONDITIONAL conditions are expressed (declared predicate over c6/c5, evaluated at VALIDATE) and how FORBIDDEN blocks. Encode acceptance criteria: presence declared per application/workflow; missing REQUIRED blocks assembly; omitted OPTIONAL/CONDITIONAL components receive an omission reason; empty components are never silently serialized as meaningful context.
agent_hints.input_context: Omission reason values are owned by ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md; this document only requires that one be recorded. The presence check runs in the VALIDATE stage. The assembly contract inputs already mark c1 and c6 required and c2–c5 nullable — presence policy refines this per scope, never contradicting it.
agent_hints.validation: The four presence values must be defined once here. Presence must be stated as application policy bound to policy_scope. Both BriefDesk policy_scopes must declare all six components. The four acceptance criteria must be decidable. CONDITIONAL must have a predicate definition.

description.th: ทำไมไม่ใช่ทุก query ต้องมี c1..c6 ครบ
description.en: Why not every query needs all of c1..c6.

items.text_th: Rationale — การยัดทุก component เข้า context เพียงเพราะ framework มีหก component สร้าง unnecessary context และ coupling; Formalization บอกบทบาทของ component ไม่ได้บังคับการใช้
items.text_en: Rationale — stuffing every component into context just because the framework has six creates unnecessary context and coupling; formalization states each component's role, it does not mandate its use

items.text_th: Application Policy — presence เป็น policy ของ application ที่ผูกกับ policy_scope ไม่ใช่ universal constant ตาม CONSTRAINTS.md; project หนึ่งมีได้หลาย policy
items.text_en: Application Policy — presence is an application policy bound to a policy_scope, not a universal constant per CONSTRAINTS.md; one project may have several policies

description.th: สี่ค่าและความหมาย
description.en: The four values and their meaning.

items.text_th: REQUIRED / OPTIONAL — REQUIRED: ต้องมีอย่างน้อยหนึ่ง item มิฉะนั้น block assembly; OPTIONAL: มีหรือไม่มีก็ได้ ถ้าไม่มีต้องบันทึก omission reason
items.text_en: REQUIRED / OPTIONAL — REQUIRED: at least one item must be present or assembly is blocked; OPTIONAL: may be present or absent, absence recorded with an omission reason

items.text_th: CONDITIONAL / FORBIDDEN — CONDITIONAL: required เมื่อ predicate ที่ประกาศเป็นจริง (เช่น query.subtasks มี live_search); FORBIDDEN: ห้ามปรากฏใน C ของ scope นี้ — พบแล้ว block assembly (ผลเดียวกับ REJECT_ASSEMBLY แต่บันทึกใน manifest เป็น presence violation ไม่ใช่ conflict)
items.text_en: CONDITIONAL / FORBIDDEN — CONDITIONAL: required when a declared predicate holds (e.g. query.subtasks contains live_search); FORBIDDEN: must not appear in C for this scope — presence blocks assembly (same effect as REJECT_ASSEMBLY, but logged in the manifest as a presence violation, not a conflict)

items.text_th: Predicate Form — condition เป็น declared predicate over c6 / c5 field ที่ประเมินใน stage VALIDATE ของ ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md ไม่ใช่ LLM judgment
items.text_en: Predicate Form — a condition is a declared predicate over c6 / c5 fields evaluated in the VALIDATE stage of ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md, not an LLM judgment

items.text_en: BriefDesk Scopes — BRIEFDESK_DAILY_BRIEF: c1 REQUIRED, c2 REQUIRED, c3 CONDITIONAL (query needs live search), c4 OPTIONAL, c5 REQUIRED, c6 REQUIRED; BRIEFDESK_COMPLIANCE_QA: c1 REQUIRED, c2 REQUIRED, c3 REQUIRED (artifact_fetch/kb_query), c4 CONDITIONAL (same case), c5 REQUIRED, c6 REQUIRED

description.th: สี่เกณฑ์ที่ตัดสินได้
description.en: Four decidable criteria.

items.text_th: Declared and Enforced — presence policy ประกาศต่อ application/workflow; missing REQUIRED block assembly ภายใต้ policy นั้นใน code
items.text_en: Declared and Enforced — a presence policy is declared per application/workflow; a missing REQUIRED component blocks assembly under that policy in code

items.text_th: Omission Recorded — OPTIONAL/CONDITIONAL ที่ถูกละมี omission reason ใน ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md; component ว่างไม่ถูก serialize เป็น context ที่มีความหมาย (ไม่ส่ง "Memory: none" เป็น section)
items.text_en: Omission Recorded — an omitted OPTIONAL/CONDITIONAL component has an omission reason in ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md; an empty component is never serialized as meaningful context (no "Memory: none" section)

description.th: Contract context_assembly_contract/v2.0 — A = Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize, inputs, ordering_policy และ component_layout ที่ application ประกาศ, omission policy, optimization_fields ที่เป็น null และ outputs
description.en: The context_assembly_contract/v2.0 contract — A = Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize, inputs, the application-declared ordering_policy and component_layout, omission policy, null optimization_fields and outputs.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md specifying context_assembly_contract/v2.0. Define A as an explicit assembly contract — not an optimizer, not bound to text output — that converts validated components into the logical model-visible bundle C; the runtime adapter then maps C to a payload (RUNTIME_BINDING.md). Decompose A = Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize and describe each stage: NORMALIZE (canonical representation), VALIDATE (reject/flag invalid items, presence check), RESOLVE_CONFLICTS (apply GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md policies), ORDER (logical dependency/presentation order per declared ordering_policy), PACKAGE (bundle per declared component_layout). Specify inputs (c1_instructions required, c6_query required, c2–c5 optional nullable), ordering_policy and component_layout as value null with the note that the application must declare them (no universal prompt order), omission_policy {allow_optional_components: true, require_omission_reason_in_manifest: true} and own the omission reason values (NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_TASK, EMPTY, SUPERSEDED_BY_STATE, PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED, FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY, STALE, CONDITION_NOT_MET). Specify runtime_adapter {adapter_id, adapter_version} null placeholders, optimization_fields {strategy_selection, component_weights, information_value_metrics} all value null with owner_module, and outputs {context_bundle required, rendered_text nullable, assembly_manifest required}. Encode the acceptance criteria (determinism under frozen inputs/versions; every included item traceable; omitted optional components have reasons; policy invariants machine-identifiable after packaging; nondeterministic transforms persist artifacts). Contrast formalization/assembly vs measurement vs optimization. Show the BriefDesk assembly briefdesk_assembly/v3.
agent_hints.input_context: Conflict classes and outcomes come from GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md; presence values from PRESENCE_POLICY.md; provenance shape from PROVENANCE_MODEL.md. This document owns assembly stage names and omission reason values. The deterministic reference implementation is in SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md; the manifest shape in ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md; the adapter in RUNTIME_BINDING.md. Read references/llm-runtime-context-shapes.md so component_layout is described as a mapping to runtime fields, never as one concatenated string.
agent_hints.validation: The five stages must appear in composition order with what each does. ordering_policy and component_layout must be value null with the application-declares note. optimization_fields must all be null with owner_module. Omission reason values must be defined once here. The five acceptance criteria must be decidable. The document must state that A is not an optimizer.

description.th: A คือ assembly contract ไม่ใช่ optimizer
description.en: A is an assembly contract, not an optimizer.

items.text_th: Definition — A คือ explicit procedure ที่เปลี่ยน formalized components เป็น model-visible context bundle C: C = A(c1, …, c6); ใน template นี้ A เป็น assembly contract ไม่ใช่ optimizer และไม่ผูกว่า output ต้องเป็น text string
items.text_en: Definition — A is the explicit procedure that turns formalized components into the model-visible context bundle C: C = A(c1, …, c6); in this template A is an assembly contract, not an optimizer, and its output is not bound to be a text string

items.text_th: Why Explicit — ถ้า assembly เป็น ad hoc string concatenation หรือ mapping logic ที่ซ่อนหลายจุด เราจะ trace, compare, test และ reproduce ไม่ได้
items.text_en: Why Explicit — when assembly is ad hoc string concatenation or mapping logic hidden in several places, it cannot be traced, compared, tested or reproduced

items.text_th: Adapter Separation — หลังได้ logical C แล้ว RuntimePayload = S_runtime(C) โดย adapter ใน RUNTIME_BINDING.md ซึ่งอาจแยก instructions, messages, tools, multimodal parts เป็น structured fields
items.text_en: Adapter Separation — once the logical C exists, RuntimePayload = S_runtime(C) via the adapter in RUNTIME_BINDING.md, which may split instructions, messages, tools and multimodal parts into structured fields

description.th: Normalize → Validate → Resolve → Order → Package
description.en: Normalize → Validate → Resolve → Order → Package.

items.text_th: NORMALIZE and VALIDATE — NORMALIZE: canonical representation ของทุก item (typed model, canonical JSON); VALIDATE: reject/flag item ที่ผิด contract, ตรวจ envelope, staleness, presence policy ตาม PRESENCE_POLICY.md — missing REQUIRED หยุดที่นี่
items.text_en: NORMALIZE and VALIDATE — NORMALIZE: canonical representation of every item (typed model, canonical JSON); VALIDATE: reject/flag contract-violating items, check envelope, staleness and the presence policy per PRESENCE_POLICY.md — a missing REQUIRED component stops here

items.text_th: RESOLVE_CONFLICTS — detect → classify → select matching governance policy → apply → outcome ตาม GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md; REJECT_ASSEMBLY หยุด pipeline; ทุก outcome ลง manifest
items.text_en: RESOLVE_CONFLICTS — detect → classify → select the matching governance policy → apply → outcome per GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md; REJECT_ASSEMBLY halts the pipeline; every outcome is logged in the manifest

items.text_th: ORDER and PACKAGE — ORDER: logical dependency / presentation order ตาม ordering_policy ที่ประกาศ; PACKAGE: จัด item เข้า component_layout เป็น bundle C พร้อม bundle hash — อ่านสมการจากขวาไปซ้าย A = Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize
items.text_en: ORDER and PACKAGE — ORDER: logical dependency / presentation order per the declared ordering_policy; PACKAGE: place items into the component_layout as bundle C with a bundle hash — read the equation right to left, A = Package ∘ Order ∘ Resolve ∘ Validate ∘ Normalize

items.text_th: Two Gates Inside the Stages — A ยังมีห้าขั้นเท่าเดิม แต่มีสอง gate ที่ตัดสินได้อยู่ภายใน: isolation gate ทำงานใน VALIDATE ก่อน presence check ตาม ACCESS_CONTROL.md และ capacity preflight gate ทำงานคั่นระหว่าง ORDER กับ PACKAGE ตาม ASSEMBLY_RUN.md; ทั้งคู่ไม่ใช่ขั้นที่หก เพราะไม่ได้แปลงรูป item แต่ตัดสินว่าจะเดินต่อ ตัดตามลำดับที่ประกาศ หรือหยุด
items.text_en: Two Gates Inside the Stages — A still has five stages, but two decidable gates live inside them: the isolation gate runs in VALIDATE before the presence check per ACCESS_CONTROL.md, and the capacity preflight gate sits between ORDER and PACKAGE per ASSEMBLY_RUN.md; neither is a sixth stage, because neither transforms an item — they decide whether to proceed, drop in the declared order, or stop

description.th: inputs, ordering_policy, component_layout, omission_policy
description.en: Inputs, ordering_policy, component_layout, omission_policy.

items.text_th: Inputs — c1_instructions (object required), c6_query (object required), c2_knowledge / c3_tools / c4_memory / c5_state (object optional nullable); presence policy ต่อ scope refine ได้แต่ห้ามขัด
items.text_en: Inputs — c1_instructions (object, required), c6_query (object, required), c2_knowledge / c3_tools / c4_memory / c5_state (object, optional, nullable); a per-scope presence policy may refine but never contradict this

items.text_th: ordering_policy and component_layout — ordering_policy (type string, value null) และ component_layout (type object, value null) ตาม workshop: application ต้องประกาศ logical ordering/dependency policy และ mapping ว่า component ไหนไปอยู่ runtime field ใด; ห้ามสมมติ universal prompt order
items.text_en: ordering_policy and component_layout — ordering_policy (type string, value null) and component_layout (type object, value null) as in the workshop: the application must declare the logical ordering/dependency policy and which component maps to which runtime field; never assume a universal prompt order

items.text_th: omission_policy — allow_optional_components: true, require_omission_reason_in_manifest: true; omission reason ∈ {NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_TASK, EMPTY, SUPERSEDED_BY_STATE, PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED, FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY, STALE, CONDITION_NOT_MET, OUT_OF_SECURITY_SCOPE, SOURCE_REVOKED, CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, REDACTED_BY_POLICY} — workshop ให้แค่ NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_TASK และ EMPTY; ค่าที่เหลือเป็น application-defined example ที่ template เพิ่ม นิยามที่เดียวที่นี่ โดยสี่ค่าท้ายมาจาก ACCESS_CONTROL.md, KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md, ASSEMBLY_RUN.md และ DATA_LIFECYCLE.md ตามลำดับ
items.text_en: omission_policy — allow_optional_components: true, require_omission_reason_in_manifest: true; omission reason ∈ {NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_TASK, EMPTY, SUPERSEDED_BY_STATE, PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED, FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY, STALE, CONDITION_NOT_MET, OUT_OF_SECURITY_SCOPE, SOURCE_REVOKED, CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, REDACTED_BY_POLICY} — the workshop shows only NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_TASK and EMPTY; the rest are application-defined examples added by the template, defined once here, the last four arising in ACCESS_CONTROL.md, KNOWLEDGE_SPEC.md, ASSEMBLY_RUN.md and DATA_LIFECYCLE.md respectively

description.th: field ที่เป็น null พร้อม owner_module และเส้นแบ่งกับ measurement/optimization
description.en: Null fields with owner_module and the line to measurement/optimization.

items.text_th: optimization_fields — strategy_selection (owner_module decision_formulation), component_weights (owner_module decision_formulation), information_value_metrics (owner_module information_theory) — value null ทุกตัวตาม CONSTRAINTS.md
items.text_en: optimization_fields — strategy_selection (owner_module decision_formulation), component_weights (owner_module decision_formulation), information_value_metrics (owner_module information_theory) — every value null per CONSTRAINTS.md

items.text_th: Three Questions — Formalization/Assembly: component นี้คืออะไรและ represent/package อย่างไร; Measurement/Evaluation: candidate นี้ให้ signal แบบใด; Optimization: เลือกแบบไหนภายใต้ objective/constraints — เอกสารนี้ตอบข้อแรกเท่านั้น รายละเอียดใน HANDOFF.md
items.text_en: Three Questions — Formalization/Assembly: what is this component and how is it represented/packaged; Measurement/Evaluation: what signal does this candidate give; Optimization: which to choose under objective/constraints — this document answers only the first; details in HANDOFF.md

items.text_th: Weighted Assembly Mistake — "Knowledge = 40%, Memory = 20%" เป็น configuration choice ไม่ใช่ formalization truth; เก็บเป็น downstream configuration พร้อม source ของค่า
items.text_en: Weighted Assembly Mistake — "Knowledge = 40%, Memory = 20%" is a configuration choice, not formalization truth; keep it as downstream configuration with the source of the value recorded

description.th: outputs สามตัวและห้าเกณฑ์
description.en: The three outputs and five criteria.

items.text_th: Outputs — context_bundle (object required), rendered_text (string nullable — text-centric representation หนึ่ง ไม่ใช่นิยามสากลของ C), assembly_manifest (object required ตาม ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md)
items.text_en: Outputs — context_bundle (object, required), rendered_text (string, nullable — one text-centric representation, not the universal definition of C), assembly_manifest (object, required per ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md)

items.text_th: Determinism — same validated inputs + frozen derived artifacts + same assembly version + same adapter version ให้ bundle/payload เดิม เมื่อ transform ที่ configure ทั้งหมด deterministic; nondeterministic transform ต้อง persist artifact ถ้าต้อง exact replay
items.text_en: Determinism — the same validated inputs + frozen derived artifacts + same assembly version + same adapter version yield the same bundle/payload when all configured transforms are deterministic; nondeterministic transforms persist their artifact when exact replay is required

items.text_th: Traceability and Invariants — ทุก included logical item trace ไป source/derived artifact ได้ (PROVENANCE_MODEL.md); omitted optional component มี reason; policy invariant ยัง machine-identifiable หลัง packaging
items.text_en: Traceability and Invariants — every included logical item traces to a source/derived artifact (PROVENANCE_MODEL.md); omitted optional components have reasons; policy invariants remain machine-identifiable after packaging

description.th: ตัวอย่าง assembly หนึ่งรอบของ BriefDesk — policy ที่ประกาศและผลของทั้งห้าขั้นต่อ run ctx_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001
description.en: One BriefDesk assembly run as a worked example — the declared policies and the outcome of all five stages for ctx_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001.

items.text_th: Declared Policies — ordering_policy: instructions → state → knowledge → memory → query (ประกาศโดย BriefDesk ไม่ใช่ default); component_layout: instructions → system field, knowledge + memory + state → structured content parts, tools → tool definitions field, query → final user message ตาม RUNTIME_BINDING.md
items.text_en: Declared Policies — ordering_policy: instructions → state → knowledge → memory → query (declared by BriefDesk, not a default); component_layout: instructions → system field, knowledge + memory + state → structured content parts, tools → tool definitions field, query → final user message per RUNTIME_BINDING.md

items.text_th: Run ctx_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 — NORMALIZE 27 items (c1 6, c2 12, c3 4, c4 3, c5 1, c6 1); VALIDATE ผ่าน presence BRIEFDESK_DAILY_BRIEF (c3 CONDITIONAL เป็นจริงเพราะ subtasks มี live_search); RESOLVE cf_001 RESOLVED, cf_002 ESCALATE; PACKAGE omit mem_headcount_120 (SUPERSEDED_BY_STATE) และ tool_escalate_to_human (PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED) → 25 items ใน C, bundle_hash sha256:b7d1…c0ffee
items.text_en: Run ctx_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 — NORMALIZE 27 items (c1 6, c2 12, c3 4, c4 3, c5 1, c6 1); VALIDATE passes presence BRIEFDESK_DAILY_BRIEF (c3 CONDITIONAL holds because subtasks contain live_search); RESOLVE cf_001 RESOLVED, cf_002 ESCALATE; PACKAGE omits mem_headcount_120 (SUPERSEDED_BY_STATE) and tool_escalate_to_human (PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED) → 25 items in C, bundle_hash sha256:b7d1…c0ffee

description.th: S_runtime adapter ที่แปลง C เป็น RuntimePayload, adapter id + version, ความต่างของ C / RuntimePayload / Y และ contract context_execution_boundary/v1.2 ที่ผูก context → payload → execution
description.en: The S_runtime adapter that maps C to a RuntimePayload, adapter id + version, the C / RuntimePayload / Y distinction and the context_execution_boundary/v1.2 contract linking context → payload → execution.

suggested_headings: What C, RuntimePayload and Y Carry

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a RUNTIME_BINDING.md covering the boundary c1..c6 → A → C → S_runtime → RuntimePayload → M → Y. Define C (logical model-visible bundle / execution input), RuntimePayload (runtime-specific representation of C), Y (output/action/result). Explain that S_runtime may be near-identity for some runtimes and for others must split instructions, messages, tool schemas and content parts into separate fields — read references/llm-runtime-context-shapes.md and describe the mapping provider-neutrally. List what each of C, RuntimePayload and Y carries (C: logical components, structured tool definitions, message/content parts, component coverage, source/derived linkage, assembly version, manifest id; RuntimePayload: runtime request shape, adapter id + version, payload hash/ref; Y: model output/action, tool calls, citations, task result, evaluator outcomes). Specify context_execution_boundary/v1.2: context_artifact {context_id, assembly_version, manifest_id, context_bundle, runtime_adapter_id, runtime_adapter_version, runtime_payload_hash_or_ref (all required), rendered_text (nullable)} and execution_result {execution_id, context_id, runtime_payload_hash_or_ref, model_or_agent_id, output} all required. Record token/latency budget of the runtime target as declared metadata. Encode acceptance criteria (every output linked to the exact payload/context artifact; re-running evaluation never mutates the original context artifact; context, payload and output versions independently identifiable). Show the BriefDesk adapter provider_adapter_x/v2.1.
agent_hints.input_context: Read references/llm-runtime-context-shapes.md for the provider-neutral field kinds and the three adapter shapes. The adapter is a separate concern from logical assembly (ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md) and is versioned independently. Debug value: separate 'no evidence in C' from 'runtime did not send the field' from 'model ignored the evidence' (ARCHITECTURE.md). Never name a real provider; describe field kinds generically (system/instructions field, message list, tool-definition list, content parts, metadata).
agent_hints.validation: C, RuntimePayload and Y must each have a definition and a list of what they carry. S_runtime must be described as a mapping to runtime fields, not a string concatenation, with the near-identity case mentioned. Every field of both contract blocks must state required/nullable. The three acceptance criteria must be decidable. No real provider name may appear.

description.th: สาม lifecycle ที่ห้ามปน
description.en: Three lifecycles that must not mix.

items.text_th: Chain — c1..c6 → A → C → S_runtime → RuntimePayload → M → Y; C คือสิ่งที่ model ถูกทำให้มองเห็นก่อน execution, RuntimePayload คือ representation เฉพาะ runtime, Y คือสิ่งที่ระบบทำออกมา
items.text_en: Chain — c1..c6 → A → C → S_runtime → RuntimePayload → M → Y; C is what the model is made to see before execution, RuntimePayload the runtime-specific representation, Y what the system produces

items.text_th: Why Separate — ทีมมักประเมิน output แล้วเรียกว่า context quality หรือมอง C เป็น prompt string ทำให้ไม่รู้ว่าปัญหามาจาก input representation, runtime mapping, model หรือ evaluator
items.text_en: Why Separate — teams evaluate the output and call it context quality, or treat C as a prompt string, and then cannot tell whether the problem is input representation, runtime mapping, the model or the evaluator

items.text_th: Near-Identity vs Structured — บาง runtime S_runtime เกือบเป็น identity; บาง runtime ต้องแยก instructions, messages, tool schemas, content parts เป็นคนละ field — ทั้งสองกรณี adapter มี id + version
items.text_en: Near-Identity vs Structured — for some runtimes S_runtime is nearly identity; for others it must split instructions, messages, tool schemas and content parts into separate fields — in both cases the adapter has an id + version

sections.heading: What C, RuntimePayload and Y Carry

description.th: รายการต่อ artifact
description.en: Contents per artifact.

items.text_th: C — logical model-visible components, structured tool definitions เมื่อมี, message / content parts เมื่อมี, component coverage, source / derived-artifact linkage, assembly version, manifest id
items.text_en: C — logical model-visible components, structured tool definitions when present, message / content parts when present, component coverage, source / derived-artifact linkage, assembly version, manifest id

items.text_th: RuntimePayload — runtime / provider request shape, runtime adapter id + version, payload hash/ref เมื่อ audit ต้องการ exact execution linkage; token/latency budget ของ target บันทึกเป็น declared metadata ไม่ optimize ที่นี่
items.text_en: RuntimePayload — the runtime / provider request shape, runtime adapter id + version, payload hash/ref when audit needs exact execution linkage; the target's token/latency budget recorded as declared metadata, not optimized here

items.text_th: Y — model output / action, tool calls, citations, task result, evaluator outcomes — tool call ใน Y เป็น runtime event ไม่ใช่ c3 ตาม TOOLS_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Y — model output / action, tool calls, citations, task result, evaluator outcomes — a tool call in Y is a runtime event, not c3, per TOOLS_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Payload Logs Are Artifacts Too — runtime payload log ถือสำเนาของทุกอย่างที่ส่งให้ model รวมถึง personal data ที่อยู่ใน c4/c5/c6 จึงมี retention class ของตัวเองตาม DATA_LIFECYCLE.md; log ที่หมดอายุแล้วถูกทำลายตาม disposition และการหายไปของมันลดข้ออ้าง replay เป็น traceable ไม่ใช่ทำให้ validation FAIL
items.text_en: Payload Logs Are Artifacts Too — a runtime payload log holds a copy of everything sent to the model, including personal data from c4/c5/c6, so it carries its own retention class per DATA_LIFECYCLE.md; an expired log is destroyed per its disposition, and its absence downgrades the replay claim to traceable rather than failing validation

description.th: mapping จาก component_layout ไป runtime field แบบ provider-neutral
description.en: Provider-neutral mapping from component_layout to runtime fields.

items.text_th: Field Kinds — system / instructions field, message list (role-tagged), tool-definition list (name + JSON Schema), content parts (text / image / structured JSON), runtime metadata — ตาม references/llm-runtime-context-shapes.md; component_layout ของ ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md ระบุว่า component ไหนไป field ไหน
items.text_en: Field Kinds — system / instructions field, role-tagged message list, tool-definition list (name + JSON Schema), content parts (text / image / structured JSON), runtime metadata — per references/llm-runtime-context-shapes.md; the component_layout in ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md says which component goes to which field

items.text_th: Adapter Identity — adapter_id + adapter_version บันทึกทุกครั้ง; เปลี่ยน mapping = เปลี่ยน version; A/B context experiment ต้องรู้ว่า Y มาจาก C + adapter version ไหน
items.text_en: Adapter Identity — adapter_id + adapter_version are recorded every time; changing the mapping bumps the version; an A/B context experiment must know which C + adapter version produced Y

items.text_th: Multimodal Rule — text, image และ tool definitions ไปคนละ content/runtime field — ไม่บังคับให้ทุกอย่างเป็น string
items.text_en: Multimodal Rule — text, images and tool definitions go to separate content/runtime fields — nothing forces everything into one string

description.th: runtime_capacity_profile/v1.0 — สิ่งที่ adapter ต้องประกาศเพื่อให้ capacity gate นับได้จริง
description.en: runtime_capacity_profile/v1.0 — what the adapter must declare so the capacity gate can actually count.

items.text_th: Profile Fields — runtime_capacity_profile/v1.0: {max_context_tokens (integer, required), reserved_output_tokens (integer, required), per_field_overhead (object, required — token ที่ runtime field แต่ละอันกินเองก่อนใส่เนื้อหา), tokenizer_id และ tokenizer_version (string, required), measurement_method (string, required)}; profile ผูกกับ adapter_id/adapter_version เพราะการนับ token เป็นเรื่องเฉพาะ runtime ไม่ใช่ค่าสากล
items.text_en: Profile Fields — runtime_capacity_profile/v1.0: {max_context_tokens (integer, required), reserved_output_tokens (integer, required), per_field_overhead (object, required — the tokens each runtime field costs before any content goes in), tokenizer_id and tokenizer_version (string, required), measurement_method (string, required)}; the profile binds to adapter_id/adapter_version because token counting is runtime-specific, never universal

items.text_th: Budget ≠ Limit — max_context_tokens คือเพดานของ runtime ส่วน budget ที่ใช้จริงคือเพดานลบ reserved_output_tokens และลบ headroom สำหรับ tool result ที่ยังไม่เกิด; การวางแผนจนเต็มเพดานคือการวางแผนให้ payload ล้นตอน run จริง
items.text_en: Budget ≠ Limit — max_context_tokens is the runtime's ceiling; the budget actually available is that ceiling minus reserved_output_tokens and minus headroom for tool results that have not happened yet — planning up to the ceiling is planning to overflow at run time

items.text_th: Reconciliation After Serialization — หลัง S_runtime สร้าง payload จริงแล้ว adapter ต้องเทียบขนาดที่ได้กับ accounted_total ที่ gate คำนวณไว้ ส่วนต่างที่เกิน tolerance ที่ประกาศคือ CAPACITY_BINDING_MISMATCH ซึ่ง fail closed ที่ execution boundary และบังคับให้ bump adapter version — เพราะ accounting ที่คลาดจากความจริงทำให้ gate ทั้งอันไร้ความหมาย
items.text_en: Reconciliation After Serialization — once S_runtime has built the real payload, the adapter compares its actual size against the accounted_total the gate computed; a difference beyond the declared tolerance is CAPACITY_BINDING_MISMATCH, which fails closed at the execution boundary and forces an adapter version bump — accounting that drifts from reality makes the whole gate meaningless

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST.md specifying context_assembly_manifest/v1.3 — the structured audit artifact describing the lineage of C and its runtime representation. Explain why: with only a final prompt string or request object nobody knows which components were included, omitted, transformed or conflict-resolved, and exact replay is impossible. Specify the manifest: context_id, assembly_version, included_items[] {item_id, component, source_artifact_id, input_content_hash, transform_ref (nullable object: transformation_id, transformation_version, transformation_config_hash, produced_artifact_id), packaged_field}, omitted_items[] {item_id or component, reason}, conflicts[] {conflict_id, type, outcome, policy_ref, selected_artifact_ref, preserve_history}, context_bundle {bundle_hash}, runtime_adapter {adapter_id, adapter_version, runtime_payload_hash_or_ref}, optional component_counts and downstream_owner. Make the traceable vs reproducible distinction explicit: a basic manifest (item ids, component mapping, omission reasons, conflict outcomes) is auditable; a frozen manifest + artifacts (source/derived hashes, transformation ids + versions + config hashes, persisted nondeterministic outputs, assembly version, adapter version, final bundle/payload hash) supports exact replay within the declared boundary. Encode the seven acceptance criteria. Describe manifest diffing (Assembly A vs B: which items added, removed, transformed, which conflicts resolved differently — never by diffing prompt strings). Show the full BriefDesk manifest mf_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001.

Omission reason values come from ASSEMBLY_CONTRACT.md; conflict types/outcomes from GOVERNANCE_MODEL.md; transform_ref shape from PROVENANCE_MODEL.md; adapter fields from RUNTIME_BINDING.md. The worked manifest must include at least one transformed item, one omitted item with reason and both conflicts.

description.th: สองระดับของ manifest
description.en: Two levels of manifest.

items.text_th: Basic Manifest → Traceable / Auditable — item ids, component mapping, omission reasons, conflict outcomes; ตอบได้ว่า C มาจากอะไร แต่ยังไม่รับประกันว่า regenerate ได้เหมือนเดิม
items.text_en: Basic Manifest → Traceable / Auditable — item ids, component mapping, omission reasons, conflict outcomes; answers where C came from but does not guarantee identical regeneration

items.text_th: Frozen Manifest + Artifacts → Reproducible — source/derived artifact hashes, transformation ids + versions + config hashes, persisted nondeterministic outputs, assembly version, runtime adapter version, final bundle/payload hash → exact replay ภายใน boundary ที่ประกาศ
items.text_en: Frozen Manifest + Artifacts → Reproducible — source/derived artifact hashes, transformation ids + versions + config hashes, persisted nondeterministic outputs, assembly version, runtime adapter version, final bundle/payload hash → exact replay within the declared boundary

items.text_th: Claim Discipline — เรียก reproducible ได้เฉพาะเมื่อ frozen set ครบ; มิฉะนั้นเรียก traceable; RUNBOOK.md ใช้เกณฑ์นี้ใน replay procedure
items.text_en: Claim Discipline — call an assembly reproducible only when the frozen set is complete; otherwise call it traceable; RUNBOOK.md applies this rule in the replay procedure

items.text_th: Read Set Is Part of the Frozen Set — การ replay ที่ไม่มี read_set ของ run ต้นทางเป็นได้แค่ traceable เพราะไม่มีทางรู้ว่า run นั้นอ่านค่าเวอร์ชันไหนไว้; artifact ที่ถูกทำลายตาม DATA_LIFECYCLE.md ก็ลดข้ออ้างลงเหลือ traceable เช่นกัน และทั้งสองกรณีต้องระบุเหตุ ไม่ใช่ปล่อยให้คำว่า reproducible ค่อย ๆ กลายเป็นคำโฆษณา
items.text_en: Read Set Is Part of the Frozen Set — a replay without the originating run's read_set can only be traceable, because nothing says which versions that run actually read; an artifact destroyed per DATA_LIFECYCLE.md likewise downgrades the claim to traceable, and both cases must name the reason rather than letting the word reproducible quietly become marketing

description.th: เจ็ดเกณฑ์ที่ validator ใช้ตัดสินว่า manifest สมบูรณ์และผูกกับ bundle / payload ได้
description.en: The seven criteria a validator uses to decide that a manifest is complete and bound to its bundle / payload.

items.text_th: Items — ทุก included item มี component + source/derived artifact linkage; transformed item มี transform/version/config linkage ตามระดับ audit ที่ use case ต้องการ; nondeterministic transform ที่ต้อง exact replay เก็บ produced artifact จริง
items.text_en: Items — every included item has component + source/derived artifact linkage; transformed items have transform/version/config linkage at the audit level the use case requires; nondeterministic transforms needing exact replay keep the actual produced artifact

items.text_th: Omissions and Conflicts — ทุก omitted item มี reason เมื่อมีการพิจารณาแล้ว; conflict resolution มี policy ref + outcome
items.text_en: Omissions and Conflicts — every considered-and-omitted item has a reason; conflict resolutions have a policy ref + outcome

items.text_th: Versions and Hashes — assembly version และ runtime adapter version ถูกบันทึก; context bundle hash และ runtime payload hash/ref ผูกกับ manifest ได้
items.text_en: Versions and Hashes — assembly version and runtime adapter version are recorded; the context bundle hash and runtime payload hash/ref are bound to the manifest

description.th: เปรียบเทียบ Assembly A กับ B โดยไม่ diff prompt string

items.text_th: Why Not String Diff — prompt string diff บอกแค่ตัวอักษรเปลี่ยน ไม่บอกว่าเป็น omission, supersede, transform version หรือ adapter change; manifest diff เป็น test case ใน TEST_PLAN.md
items.text_en: Why Not String Diff — a prompt-string diff shows changed characters but not whether the cause was an omission, supersede, transform version or adapter change; manifest diffing is a TEST_PLAN.md test case
